tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄/ /phyag rgya chen po gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi zhal gdams rin po che phreng ba/ /na mo rat+na gu ru/rang sems sangs rgyas su ngo sprod pa'i rgyal ba 'bri
༄/ /phyag rgya chen po gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi zhal gdams rin po che phreng ba/ /na mo rat+na gu ru/rang sems sangs rgyas su ngo sprod pa'i rgyal ba 'bri

tei:div.tei:p: ༄// phyag rgya chen po gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi zhal gdams rin po che phreng ba// na mo rat+na gu ru/ rang sems sangs rgyas su ngo sprod pa'i rgyal ba 'bri gung pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyud ldan bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la// sgo gsum dri med dad pas rab 'dud nas// lung rig gdams pa gsung dang mi 'gal bar// bka' yi ge med pa don thog tu bsdu ba ston pa/ snying po mi brjed pa'i gzungs/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdzod/ rdo rje 'chang gi thugs kyi dgongs pa ma lus pa snyan nas snyan/ thugs nas thugs/ rig pa nas rig par brgyud pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po 'bri gung pa'i phyag rgya chen po mtshan nyid par grags pa zung 'jug yangs pa'i 'khor lo/ dgongs pa thams cad dang 'gal med du ston pa/ tshe gcig lus gcig la 'tshang rgya bar byed pa/ mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i srog snying shin tu gnyan pas bri bar mi 'os kyang*/ phyi rabs kyi don du bdag gis cung zhig bri bar bya/ de la thog ma nyid nas rang la gnas pa'i/ snying po'i don gsal byed ston pa/ rgyud ldan ma nor ba'i gdams ngag mnga' ba'i 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin po che'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ gang dag 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas gcod cing*/ bde ba chen po'i thar lam byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i gang zag dad pa dang brtson 'grus su ldan pa'i snying rus mnga' ba des/ skye shi rtsad nas gcod cing rigs dang ldan pa'i bu khyod ma yengs par gson dang spyir thub pa chen po'i gsung rab kyi sum gnyis ni/ sems bskyed dang bsngo ba gnyis yin pas sems bskyed/ lus yi dam lhar bsgom/ bla ma dam pa snying khar bsgom/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nas chos gsan par zhu/ spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs te/ der yang ma zad bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi lang bar gsungs/

de'i dgongs pa kha skong ba la/ gang zag rnams kyis bstan bcos la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa cig mdzad kyang*/ de rnams la dgos pa ci yod na/ rang gi sems nyid rang ngo shes par bya ba las med/ sems shes na chos kun shes pa yin/ mtshan brjod las kyang*/ kun shes kun rig dam pa po// ces gsungs pa dang*/ 'o na de rnams la lo bskal pa brgyad khri bye ba dung phyur du/ theg pa chen po'i chos la nyan bsam sgom zhing dka' ba sna tshogs su spyad pa de la dgos pa ci yod yis dgos pa sangs rgyas sa las med/ de kun dang thun mong ma yin pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba/ kun la grags pa'i sgra bo che/ ku co can ye gad can ming snyan po de gang yin par 'dug su yin ci la zer bar 'dug pa rang gis yar ded mar ded phar ded/ tshur ded gyis la sangs rgyas de gang la zer bar 'dug tshol cig de ltar btsal bas mi rnyed de/ gud cig na yod pa lta bu ma yin/ 'o na sangs rgyas de gang la zer na rang gi sems kho na la zer ba yin/ de yang bka' lung mdo rgyud thams cad nas/ rang gi sems 'di sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa can yin par bshad pa las/ gud cig na yod par ma bshad do// rgyud las rgyud du grags pa'i khungs gsum las dpal dgyes pa rdo rje nas/ 'jig rten khams 'di gang du yang*// sangs rgyas rnyed par mi 'gyur te// phyogs bcu dus gsum gang du yang*// sangs rgyas btsal bas rnyed mi 'gyur// sems nyid rtogs na sangs rgyas pas// sangs rgyas gzhan nas btsal mi bya// ces pa dang*/ rmad du byung ba'i rgyud las kyang*/ rang gi sems las gzhan pa'i chos// phyogs bcu 'jig rten gang nas kyang*// rgyal ba rnams kyis mi rnyed pas// de las gzhan du ma 'tshol cig mtshan brjod las/ so so rang rig mi g.yo ba// mchog gi dang po sku gsum 'chang*// zhes dang 'da' ka ye shes las/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir/

sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ mdo las/ mdo ru grags pa'i khungs gsum ni/ mdo sde spyod pa nas/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes ma 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*// dgongs 'grel las/ so so rang rig mtshan med spyod yul ba// brjod du med cing tha snyad yongs su chad// rtsod dang bral bas don dam chos yin te// de ni rtog ge kun las 'das mtshan nyid// zhes dang*/ gang zag las gang zag tu grags pa'i khungs gsum ni/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i smon lam las/ skyes ma thag tu chos dang 'phrad nas kyang*// nyan bsam sgom gsum rig pa'i rgyud sbyangs nas// ting 'dzin rtse gcig sems la dbang thob shog /dbang po drug po yul la yengs ma gyur// lus kyi yan lag rgyas shing skyon med cing*// dbang po ma nyams rig mtho bkur ba'i gnas// sangs rgyas chos rnams rdzogs par byed pa dang*// zhes dang*/ bram ze chen po'i zhal nas/ 'di ni bde chen mchog yin te// sa ra ha yis bstan nas 'grol// til+li pa'i zhal nas/ kyai ho 'di ni rang rig ste// 'di la 'khrul par ma byed cig ces dang*/ til+li nga yis ci yang bstan du med// zhes gsungs so// rje mi la'i zhal nas kyang*/ thams cad sems su ma shes na// srid pa'i gnas la dbang bsgyur kyang*// thams cad mkhyen pa thob mi srid// mnyam bzhag bzhi yi bsam gtan la// bskal par gnas kyang dman pa'i lam// gsung*/ gzhan yang khungs bsam gyis mi khyab bo// mkhas btsun dang*/ grub thob pho mo thams cad kyis kyang*/ rang gi sems yin par gsungs shing*/ der ma zad skye bo tha mal pa'i kha sngags la yang*/ dga' dang mi dga' thams cad sems yin zer/ spyir rnam bzhag tsam du'ang sems yin par 'dug snyam du sems te/

de la mi mthun pa gang yang med de thams cad mthun no// 'o na mthun pa'i sems nyid de rang gang yin snyam na/ sems brgya med stong med/ khri med gnyis med sems gcig las med/ gcig pu de rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la bkra cag ge lam me ba 'di yin/ de yang lus 'di yang sems nyid de'i rten gnas tsam las dngos min/ rten dang brten pa tsam yin/ ngag 'di sems dngos min te/ de yang sems kyi sgra brnyan nam/ brag cha tsam yin no// 'o na de la brten nas mtshon byed kyi brda sbyor yang mi nus/ 'o na lus ngag gnyis ma yin pa'i sems rang gang yin zhe na/ sems de sngun du song ba med/ phyi ru lus pa med/ phag tu gab sa med/ da lta rang gi tha mal gyi shes rig mngon sum pa 'di yin te rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhyen par sbyangs/ sgra rigs mi 'dra ba dpag tu med pa mkhyen pa bas/ de bas kyang tha mal gyi shes pa ngo shes pa dga'/ tha mal gyi shes pa ngo shes pa ni/ don dam pa'i bden pa khong du chud pa'o// tha mal gyi shes pa mi shes na/ paṇ+ḍi ta yang so so skye bo dang khyad med gsung*/ dbang bzhi rim gyis bskur nas bskyed pa'i rim pa la brtan pa thob/ yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs pa bas/ tha mal gyi shes pa ngo shes pa dga'/ tha mal gyi shes pa ngo shes pa ni don dam pa'i lha yin gsung*/ zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin nyin mtshan ngo mi shes pa yod pa bas/ tha mal gyi shes pa ngo shes pa dga'/ ting nge 'dzin de lta bu ni phyi ba la sogs pa rlung phugs su gnas pa rnams la yang yod/ nyan thos 'gog pa rnams la yang yod gsung*/ tha mal gyi shes pa ni ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi rgyal po yin gsung*/ de la dgongs nas phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ rtogs pa gcig gis sa lam ma lus bgrod// ltung ba'i rnyog ma ngo bo nyid kyis zhi// zhes gsungs pas/ tha mal gyi shes rig mngon sum pa 'di la/

phri bsnan dang nyo tshong dbye bsal bya mi dgos shing*/ bcos slad kyis gzhan nas btsal mi dgos te/ lhag chad med par rang la rang chas su grub pa tha mal gyi gnas skabs/ da lta rang rig shes pa 'di ni skye 'gag med par gnas pa/ bde sdug nyams su myong ba dang bcas pa'i shes rig mngon sum pa/ wal wal hrig hrig pa 'di kho na rang yin no// 'di la bltas pas gzugs su mthong rgyu med/ ngos gzung gang du yang ma grub cing*/ cis kyang stong pa/ de nyid cir yang gsal/ cir yang rig pa/ gsal stong dang rig stong gnyis su med cing gsal 'gag med pa'i rig pa/ byang chub sems 'di nyid mi dran dgu dran/ mi rgyu dgu rgyu/ mi rig dgu rig mi bkra dgu bkra/ mi shes dgu shes/ mi mkhyen dgu mkhyen/ mi tshor dgu tshor/ mi 'jug dgur 'jug pa'i shes pa/ tsan ne rig pa tsan ne thos pa'i sems/ da lta rang gis mngon sum du lhag ge ba 'di yin no// 'di sa rdo ri brag kun la btang kyang thogs rdugs mi 'dug gsung*/ de la dgongs nas rin po che'i zhal nas/ rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs la// go rim med pa'i rnal 'byor pas// ci tsam nyams su blangs pas phung*// bsgom pas phung*/ bcos pas brlag gsung*/ mi la rnal 'byor gyi zhal nas/ phyi rig pa'i 'char tshul mi shes par// nang gti mug gi glen sgom ma byed cig /ngan song gsum du skye nyen gda'// gsung*/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas shar chu bo gaṅgā tshun chod la stong nyid sgom shes pa kho bo min pa med/ 'o na yod kyis dang gsung*/ rin po che la la drug pas zhus pa/ stong nyid bsgom shes pa'i go ba gang lags zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos thams cad gdod ma nas stong par gnas shing*/ mtshan ma cir yang mi 'dzin pa ni/ stong nyid sgom pa yin gyis/ stong pa cig blo yul du byas nas bsgom pa ni ma yin gsung*/ lar 'di'i gnad mi bsgom pa gcig pu yin gsung*/

rgya che rol pa las/ bsgom na 'ching ba chen po ste// mi bsgom 'bral ba med ces gsung*// sems nyid rnam par ma bcos pas// chos kyi rgyal srid 'thob par 'gyur// zhes gsung*/ de ltar kun la chags thogs med pa rdo rje'i lus de nyid rtogs na/ dpe rin po che gser gling du phyin pa dang 'dra ste/ thams cad rin po cher gyur pa ltar/ rang sems rin po che'i gter mthong bar 'gyur gsung*/ phyag rgya chen po 'di chos spyi'i chings yin pas/ 'di chos thams cad la dbang sgyur ba'i rgyal po yin/ 'dis chos thams cad kyi mi shes pa thams cad sel bar byed pas ye shes kyi spyan yin/ shes rab kyi mig yin/ 'di la dam tshig gcig yod de khyed kyis thub bam gsung*/ cis kyang gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ 'di gzhan du gsang ba'i bka' rgya yod pas/ khyed kyis go bar gyis/ shes par gyis/ 'di sgom nas sa bon kha gsum pa dang 'dra bas ma bsgom/ bsgom na dam tshig nyams gsung*/ rje mi la'i zhal nas ro gcig gi rtogs pa med par tshogs pa skyong ba las/ mda' gzhu khyer nas lings byed pa drag gsung*/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ ngas ni thams cad sems su go// byed pa thams cad kun rdzob la// byed med rtogs pas mya ngan 'das// gsung*/ mdo sde dkon mchog sprin las/ byang chub snying por bzhugs pa'i tshe// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// dri ma sna tshogs gzhan dag kyang*// khyod kyi ye shes me yis bsregs// ces gsungs pas/ tha mal shes rig mngon sum pa ma rtogs pa spyi la gnas pa thogs rdugs med pa/ nam mkha' lta bu'i thogs rdugs kun dang bral ba'i rig pa/ byang chub kyi sems 'di/ 'das ma 'ongs da ltar du rang byung du grub pa yin/ 'di la dus dang mtshams med/ zangs thal du gnas pas de ltar rgyun chad med par gnas pa yin/ gnas lugs 'di dang sngar 'bral ma myong zhing*/ da dbral bas mi 'phral zhing*/

'bral mi shes pa'i chos nyid yin pas/ 'di bkaka pas mi khegs/ btang bas mi thengs/ bsubs pas bsub par mi 'gyur/ phye bas mi phyed/ bshig pas mi zhig cing zhig nas mi 'gro/ rang sems sangs rgyas kyi snying po 'di// gang gis bsgyur kyang mi 'gyur la// nam mkha' bzhin du dngos med la// btang bas mi 'gro yong ba med// ye gdod ma nyid nas 'gro 'ong 'pho 'gyur med par gnas so// de ltar yum chen mo las/ sems la 'gyur ba med cing*/ rnam par rtog pa med pa'o zhes gsungs so// 'o na rig pa'i ye shes 'di la sa chu me rlung 'byung ba bzhis kyang bsub pa dang khyer ba dang 'tshig pa dang g.yo ba la sogs pa gang gis gnod pas kyang mi tshugs shing*/ mtshon la sogs pas kyang rig pa 'di la gcad du med/ 'di la skad cig tsam yang skye shi med pas 'dus ma byas pa'i ye shes yin/ de lta bu de rang byung rang shar rten med gnas dang bral bas na/ 'di la skye ba dang 'gag pa dang gnas pa ye nas bral lo// de lta bu'i rig pa 'di ya da rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ ma da 'jag mig gi srin bu yan chad la chos skus khyab par gnas shing*/ bzang ngan dang che chung dang nye ring dang mtho dman gang yang med/ phyogs dang ris med par mnyam pa nyid du gnas so// 'di la phyi dang nang dang dbus dang mtha' kun las grol bar 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos/ bltas pas don bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ rgya dang tshad kun las 'das pa'o// de lta bu'i rig pa byang chub sems 'di ni gzhan sems lta bu ma yin te/ rang gi sems kho na yin pas/ de min pa cig bzang por bsgyur nas bcos slad mi bya ste/ bu rang tha mal gyi shes pa 'di rang kho na yin pas na/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs dgongs shig 'o skol la tshur mi sbyor te/ so so rang re la rang chas su yod pa 'di la bri bsnan dang*/ dbye bsal spang blang gang yang bya mi dgos so// rang sems blo yis ma bslad na// 'di ni dpal ldan chen po yin// zhes pa 'di la lhag chad gang yang med// mang nyung med/

rjes dpag dang lkog tu skad cig kyang sbas pa med de/ da lta rang gi shes rig mngon sum pa 'di kho na rang yin no// 'di nyid la mang po med de/ gcig las yod mi srid/ gcig po 'di las yun du byas kyang bogs mi thon/ med par byas kyang de las med par mi 'gro/ des na 'di la phral thabs dang 'chug thabs med/ bsnyon thabs dang 'gyur thabs gcig kyang med pas/ sems nyid gcig pu 'di thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin no// de ltar na snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi rig pa byang chub kyi sems yin pa la/ yin par rang gis ma shes ma rig ma go ba de la/ sngar bzhin bla ma dam pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa bstan pa ni/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lha ru bsgom/ snying gi dkyil du bla ma dam pa gsal bar bsgom/ gsal ba'i tshad ni khab mig tu skud pa brgyu ba'i tshad du bya/ sems bskyed pa de rang phyag rgya chen po yin/ yi dam gyi lha dang bla ma dam pa bsgom pa de rang phyag rgya chen po yin/ logs na ni bsgom du med/ spyir phyag rgya chen po la goms par bya/ 'dris par bya/ shes par bya'o gsung*/ seṅge rnam par brtse ba'i ting nge 'dzin zhes ngo sprod gsung ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad skyil krung 'di rang la yod pas/ 'khrul 'khor legs par bcas/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par byas pas/ rtog pa rang zhi rang 'gags mi bsgom/ babs la gnas pa yin gsung*/ chos rje'i rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ sems babs la gnas na mkhas pa yin// lus drang por srong la nga la nyon// ces gsungs pa dang*/ mtshan brjod las/ rdo rje dkyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas// sems la 'gyur ba med cing rnam par rtog pa med ces 'bum las gsungs pa dang*/ bram ze chen po'i zhal nas/ yid la mi byed phyag rgya che// 'bras bu gang la'ang ma re rnal 'byor pa// ces gsungs pa de rnams ni/

gzhi bsgom med kyi babs sam gnas lugs yin gsung*/ de ltar babs la gnas pas/ rlung a ba dhū tir tshud de/ de'i dus su rlung sems gnyis med pa'i gnad kyis/ shes pa gsal ba/ mi rtog pa/ bde ba 'byung ste/ de'i dus su bla ma gcig gis khrid nas/ khyed kyi shes pa gang rtog pa med pa de ni/ rang sems rig pa 'di kho na yin no// gzhi rig pa bgyi ba chos kyi sku'i bdag nyid yin ces ngo sprad do// khos de kho na ltar nyams su blang pas gsal ba dang*/ mi rtog pa la mchog 'dzin btang ste/ rig pa la 'di la nges shes skye bo/ rig pa de kho na gsal ba de nyid la ma yengs pa ni ting 'dzin no// rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin pa chos kyi sku/ lam rnam pa gsum ni gzhi spong ba'i lam/ gzhi bsgyur ba'i lam/ gzhi shes pa'i lam mo// gzhi spong ba'i lam ni nyon mongs pa spong bar 'dod pa/ gnyen po ye shes rgyud la skye bar 'dod pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa'o// gzhi bsgyur ba ni gsang sngags te dpe ji ltar bsgyur na/ chos thams cad phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang du bsgyur/ nang bcud kyi sems can lha dang lha mor bsgyur/ zas bdud rtsir bsgyur/ rang lhar bsgyur/ nyon mongs pa ye shes su bsgyur ba/ gzhi shes pa rdo rje theg pa ste/ chos thams cad la spang rgyu yang med/ blang rgyu yang med/ sgyur rgyu yang med de thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin/ sems skye ba med par 'od gsal bar shes pas/ gzhi shes pa'i lam mo// rdo rje 'chang gis bsgom pa po med/ sgom pa'ang med/ bsgom par bya ba cung zad med/ zhes gsungs/ sgom pa po med cing ji ltar med na/ rang rig ngos gzung dang 'dzin pa mtha' dag dang bral ba/ dpe dang tshig gis kyang mtshon du med pa/ mtshan ma'i ngos nas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis gzigs par mi 'gyur/ de'i ngo bo la bsgom bya'i yul med/

'di ltar nyams su myong bya ba med pas bsgom par bya ba cung zad med de/ 'ga' zhig ni bsgom par 'dod de rnal 'byor dbang phyug bhu su ku pa'i zhal nas/ yid la mi byed phyag rgya che gsung*/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ bsgom dang mi bsgom gnyis su med// yid la byed dam mi byed gnyis su med// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med/ 'khor ba myang 'das gnyis su med// sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su med// don dam kun rdzob gnyis su med// bsgom pa nyid kyang ye shes lags// mi bsgom pa yang ye shes lags// bsgom dang mi bsgom gnyis su med// ces gsungs shing*/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/ rnam shes ma mthong ye shes mthong*// zhes gsungs pas/ gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad zung 'jug 'khor lo bzhir bzhed do// sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos sku'i 'od// sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa ni sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha'i ngo bo de yin/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa ni de las byung ba'i rkyen snang las gyur pa'i rtog pa de yin/ de yang nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od dam/ tsan dan nam tsan dam gyi dri lta bu yin/ de la rtogs par bya ba'i chos gsum/ nyams su blang bar bya ba'i chos gsum mo// rtogs par bya ba'i chos gsum ni/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa la ci yang ma yin pa la/ snang ba sna tshogs su shar bar rtogs par bya'o// sna tshogs su shar yang don ci yang ma yin par rtogs pa bya ba dang*/ gnyis med smrar mi btub par rtogs par bya'o// nyams su blang ba'i chos gsum ni/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa la/ dang por rtsol sgrub dang bral bas lus sems babs la gnas pa dang*/ bar du the tshom med par sems ma bcos par so mar gnas pa dang*/ tha ma byung tshor thams cad skye med du shes par bya'o// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'gro ba thams cad kyi rgyud la yod pa/

gnyug ma de bdag rang la yod pas gzhan nas btsal mi dgos pa sdug bsngal thams cad spangs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sku de rang gi rig pa 'di kho na yin/ gzhan na ye med/ snang grags kyi chos 'di thams cad rang gi sems yin/ gzhan gang nas kyang ma byung*/ khyed de la 'jigs mi dgos/ 'di'i gnad thabs mkhas kyi nyams len de yin/ de go bar gyis/ des phrin las mtha' dag 'grub/ rab 'byor gyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bgyi ba ni gang lags/ zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bgyi ba ni/ dran pas dbang bsgyur ba zhi ba'i rnam pa can/ mtshan nyid med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ de'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces gsungs so// gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid shes na chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid shes par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// sdud pa las/ shes rab kyis ni chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes nas// khams gsum ma lus pa las yang dag 'da' bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs/ de nyid las/ rig pa khyim du mi gnas lam la mkhas par 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/ ma mthong gi yul cig lta 'dod na// yul la ma lta lam la sems// ces dang*/ sdud pa las/ lus sems mkha' 'gro bya ltar rgyu// nag po rtsa lag rnams kyis glags rnyed ga la 'gyur// ces so// mtshan brjod las/ mi gnas kun 'gro khyab pa po// ces sogs/ de rnams ni gnas pa bogs 'byin pa'i lung yin gsung*/ gzhan yang lung bsam gyis mi khyab grangs las 'das so// spyir mun pa la snang ba'i ngo sprod/ snang ba la mun pa'i ngo sprod// tsha reg la grang reg grang reg la tsha reg tha dad la zung 'jug rmongs pa lug dang 'dra ba la/ nges shes gcig la skyed/ mkhas pa shes rab can la chos kyi sgo phyogs med du phye la bstan/ sdig po che la dge med sdig med gang la gang 'dul gyi chos bstan cing 'khor lo gsum gyi dbye ba rgyas par bshad do// lar 'di thabs mkhas pa dang shes rab zab mos rim gyis 'khrid pa lags gsung*/

bla mas ngo sprad pa de rnams ngo shes/ rig rtogs pas na sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa ngo sprad pa zhes bya'o// de ltar ngo sprad pa shes shing rtogs pa'i rig pa 'di nyid rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i gnas skabs na yang da ltar gyi rig pa 'di nyid rang yin te/ 'di la phri bsnan dang*/ bcos sgyur gang yang byas pa med de/ des na mdog ma sgyur cing*/ sus kyang ma bcos pa'i grwa ma chag zur ma nyams pa 'di nyid/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs sam mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin te/ dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs bsgoms ma bsgoms phyi la gnas pa de nyid/ rtogs ma rtogs rang gi snang ba la shar ba yin/ 'di nyid ngo ma shes ma rig ma rtogs pa'i dus na/ kun rdzob 'khor bar rtog pas 'khrul pa sems can yin/ 'di ngo shes shing rtogs/ go zhing yid ches pa'i dus na don dam pa mya ngan las 'das pa yang dag pa/ byang chub kyi sems yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin/ de'i phyir na rig pa'i ye shes 'di la ngo ma shes pa dang*/ mi rtogs pa'i thabs gar yod/ 'di go zhing rtogs pa'am ci skad du yin lugs bstan pa de la/ yid ches shing mos par gyis la/ khyed rnams kyis rtsa ba 'di zungs shig de ltar go zhing rtogs pa dang*/ nges pa'i shes pa skye bar byed pa ni/ dper na sngar ma mthong ba'i yul cig lta bar 'dod na/ gar thod thod du phyin pas mthong bar mi 'gyur te/ sngar gyi lam rgyus legs po yod pa cig dang 'grogs nas phyin na/ des brda sprad pa tsam gyis yul de mthong zhing nges pa'i shes pa skye'o// rgyus can de dang 'grogs nas phyin pas yul de 'dris shing goms par byas pas/ yul de gzhan gcig gis min byas kyang min par byed mi shes te/ de ci lta byas pas yul cig po de rang gis mthong zhing de las gzhan na med par kho thag rbad kyis chod pas sngar gyi de nyid la nges shes skye'o// de bzhin du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa de la bla ma dam pas/

gdams ngag gi gnad 'di lta bu cig bstan pas/ rang gi rig pa sems nyid byang chub kyi sems 'di rang la sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yin pa'i nges shes gting nas skye'o// de lta bu la blo btang snyoms su mi bzhag par lta rtog dang dpyad ra gyis/ 'dris shing goms pa la brtan par byas pas/ de sems med par bcug kyang med par mi shes so// stor du bcug kyang stor mi shes so// de ci ste byas pas sems nyid de rang ngo gting nas shes pas/ slar de nyid rang la nges shes gting nas skye'o// de ltar rang gi sems de/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yin par rang gi bla ma dam pa'i gsung sgros bzhin du nges shes skyes kyang*/ da dung phyi nang du snang ba'i dngos po 'di dag thams cad sems dang 'brel ba med par byas shing snang ba gud nas bcad nas byas pa la/ de ni de ltar ma yin te/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems nyid gcig pu'i 'khrul 'khor yin par shes par bya/ de ltar yin pa'i phyir na rang gi lus kyi bya byed dang*/ sems kyi dran rtog dang*/ ngag gi smra brjod thams cad dang*/ mdor na spyod lam rnam pa bzhir ci dang ci byed pa thams cad la/ kho min gzhan 'dug gam mi 'dug ltos dang*/ de ltar bltas pas gzhan ma yin te/ thams cad de yin par shes pa cig 'byung ngo*// dper na rgya 'bag gi mig gam gar mkhan gyi lag pa bzhin du/ sems 'di kun gyi gsang thag dang rtsa ba yin no// sgo lnga snang grags kyi chos ces skad pa wa le khyug ge ba 'di dang*/ yul 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod byed pa'i shes pa/ mthong ba thos pa/ tshor ba myong ba la sogs pa 'di thams cad kyang*/ rang gi sems kho na yin pa las/ gzhan ma yin gyi/ gal te de ma yin no zhe na/ dbang po tshang ba'i ro lta bu nges kyang*/ yul lnga po rtogs par rigs te/ des mi rtogs pa'o// des na thams cad kyi rgyur 'debs sam 'khrul 'khor yin no// gzhan yang tshe thog med pa nas/

tha ma da lta yan chod du/ 'gro drug gar skyes kyang rung*/ sems kyi bde sdug ci nyams su myong yang*/ sems nyid 'dis nyams su myong ba las ma gtogs pa/ gzhan yod mi srid de thams cad de rang yin no// mdor na rmi lam bar do 'chi ka gsum dang*/ 'di dang phyi ma dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ bde sdug btang snyoms su ci myong yang*/ sems 'di dang sngar yang 'bral ma myong*/ phyis kyang 'bral mi shes pas/ thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'di yin par kho thag chod do// de ltar snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems 'di gcig pu'i rgyur 'debs sam/ 'phrul 'khor ram 'di'i bya byed dang 'gro ldog yin pas/ des na thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems nyid gcig pu 'di yin no// de nyid thams cad kyi skor 'go'am bdag po'i tshul yin pas/ da lta sems shes na/ bar do dang po shes pas/ bar do gsum po des 'gre/ sems la mi shes pa'i thabs med/ ngas khyed tsho la ma bshad ma zer cig dran pa sad ran no// da 'di ltar snang ba'i snang srid kun kyang*/ sems de nyid rang shar ba yin pas/ dgag sgrub byar med/ ci shar dang ci snang thams cad sems 'di gcig pu'i snang tshul lam/ myong tshul lam/ spyod tshul las ma 'das pas na/ thams cad de'i grub tshul lam/ dbang chos yin/ de'i phyir na kho min gzhan min par byung bas thebs shing shes/ rtogs shing sgro 'dogs chod par bya'o// da de lta bu'i rig pa byang chub kyi sems zla med ltos med/ bzlog thub/ mnyam nyid ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs par kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par shes shing*/ rtogs pa cig dgos pa yin no// 'o na bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis de ltar rigs kyang*/ blo chung ba'i gang zag rnams la/ 'di ston pa'i chos dang 'gal lam snyam pa'i log pa'i rtogs pa skye srid pas 'di'i skabs su/ lha bla ma byang chub kyi gtam rgyud kyang gsung*/ 'di kun dang mi 'gal te/ bstan pa'i chos thams cad kyang sems 'di gcig pu 'di ngo shes shing rtogs par bya ba'i thabs dang 'di phyi brdar dang gces spras 'ba' zhig las ma gtogs pa/

gzhan skad cig kyang med pas/ da 'di ngo shes tsa na thams cad 'di'i thog kho nar 'bab pas na/ tshig dang tha snyad mi mthun pa tsam ma gtogs pa/ don 'chug gzhi dang gol dogs med pas/ thams cad 'di nyid rang yin par rigs par bya'o// de lta bu 'di 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub pas na/ rnam dag lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes chen po zhes bya'o// 'di gzhan nas btsal mi dgos shing don rang la 'byung bas na/ rang byung gi ye shes zhes bya'o// don thams cad rang la rdzogs shing che bas na/ rdzogs pa chen po zhes bya'o// sems 'dis sna tshogs su rgyur 'debs shes pas/ dper na gar mkhan gyi phyag rgya dang 'dra bas na/ sems dpa'i phyag rgya chen po zhes bya'o// ma bcos pa'i rnal 'byor blo dang yid las 'das pas na/ sems 'di gnyug ma yid la mi byed pa zhes bya'o// sems 'di dang ye gdod ma nyid nas 'bral ma myong bas na/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rig pa zhes kyang bya'o// sems 'di rtogs tsa na/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen por gnas pas na/ ma rgyud kyi dgongs pa bde stong spros bral gyi ye shes gzhi sgom med kyi ngo sprod pa dang sems 'di gsal la ma 'gags pa sna tshogs su 'char bas na/ pha rgyud kyi dgongs pa rig pa'i 'od gsal zhes bya'o// 'dul ba pha rol tu phyin pa drug gsang sngags rtsa rlung thig le dran pas dbang bsgyur ba'i chos kyi rgyal po/ lam sgom med chos thams cad tha dad med par kun gyi rtsa ba/ rig pa gcig pur 'dug pa'i phyir na/ gnyis su med pa'i rig pa byang chub kyi sems zhes bya'o// de nyid mngon du gyur na/ phrin las phyogs med du 'char bas na/ 'bras bu sgom med zhes pa/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid do/ /zog pa 'di la bzang ngan gyi skyon yon gang gis kyang ma gos par 'dug pa'i phyir na/ rig pa dri ma med pa zhes pa 'di nyid la bya'o// rig pa 'di sku gsum gyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pas na/

chos kyi sku'i bdag nyid ces bya'o// sems 'di rtogs nas sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa mthar thug par 'dug pas na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya'o// sems 'di rtogs tsa na/ 'khor ba dang rnam par rtog pa ma spangs par rang sar grol bas na/ 'di nyid la mya ngan las 'das pa'am/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes zhes bya'o// sems 'di chos thams cad kyi gzhi mar 'dug pas na/ kun gzhi byang chub kyi sems zhes bya'o// don 'di las chos thams cad 'da' bar mi nus pas na don dam pa byang chub kyi sems zhes bya'o// sems 'di 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa bar 'dug pas na/ rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems zhes bya'o// 'di chos thams cad kyi snying por 'dug pas na/ snying po byang chub kyi sems zhes bya'o// rig pa 'dis 'khor 'das thams cad skyed par byed pas na/ yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes kyang 'di yin no// don 'di tshig dang tha snyad rtog ge'i spyod yul las kun las 'dag nas 'dud pas na/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// zhes bya ba yin no// sems 'di phyogs gang du yang ma lhung zhing*/ sgro skur gyi mtha' dang bral nas 'dug pas na/ dbu ma chen po zhes kyang bya'o// sems 'di rtogs na chos thams cad spyan 'byed pa'i sgron me lta bur 'dug pas na ma rig mun sel gyi nyi zla lta bu zhes bya ba yin/ rig pa 'di chos thams cad kyi tshod 'dzin pa'i shes byed dam dpang po lta bur 'dug pas na/ mchog gi rang rig mngon sum gyi tshad ma yin no// rig pa 'di mdo 'am 'gag tu 'dug pas na/ spyi sdom bzhi pa zhes kyang 'di nyid la bya'o// rig pa 'dis chos thams cad kyi shan shun 'byed pas na bstan pa'i shan 'byed zhes kyang 'di nyid la bya'o// rig pa 'dis chos thams cad la gros 'debs shing shes bya'i sgro 'dogs thams cad gcod par byed pas/ gsang sngags don gyi tshad ma zhes kyang 'di la bya'o// de'i phyir na snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba'ang rig pa byang chub kyi sems yin pas na/

de la dgongs nas bram ze chen po'i zhal nas/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te// gang las srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba// 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi// yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems nyid dri med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di la skal ldan rnams kyis nges shes thun mong ma yin pa skye dgos so// de yang gang ltar song zhing ci ltar 'dug kyang rung ste/ rang gi sems gcig pu 'di las skad cig kyang 'da' bar ma myong bas na/ don rtsa ba gcig po 'di btsir gyis bzung la yang nas yang du 'di la nan tan bskyed cig the tshom dang yid gnyis dang khu 'phrig thams cad chod la/ bla mas ji ltar gdams pa btab pa bzhin du yid ches par gyis shig de yang sems kyi don rtsa ba gcig gsha' mar ma zin na/ lo bskal pa brgyad khri dang bzhi stong du chos byas kyang 'tshang mi rgya ste/ 'on kyang smon 'jug rgyud pa'i rgyu tsam du 'gro ba las/ gcig chod ma nor ba'i lam dang mi 'phrad do// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor 'das gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du// chos kyi rgyal po 'di ma go na// byas pa'i chos kyis 'tshang mi rgya// lar gyis 'dug lugs gcig ma shes na// ci byas 'khor ba'i gzhung lam yin// sems dang rdo rus ma 'phrod na// ma lus shes pa sgyu ma yin// sems chos dang mthun par mi ston na// tshig dang tha snyad la mkhas kyang*// 'jig rten 'di yi bla ma yin// rtogs ldan shes bya'i chos 'di la// sbyangs pa chung yang khyad par 'phags// de nyid med par gyur pas na// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// blo la bzhugs kyang gtam rgyud yin// shi ba'i nangs par brjed nas 'gro// legs pa'i skar ma ma gsan nam// rang sems rtogs par ma gyur na// shes bya'i sbyangs pa che lags kyang*/ /so so'i skye bor thub pas gsungs/ /des na don brgyud kyi gdams pa 'di'i gnad kyis/

rang la gnas pa'i don de/ bla ma'i zhal gyi gdams pas ji skad gsung bzhin du/ nges pa kho nar rtogs shing yid ches shing the tshom gyi spros pa chod na/ skyes bu de skal ba dang ldan pas/ tshe 'di phyi gnyis ka'i las zin pa yin no// de ltar yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ yang dag tshad ma ma shes na// bskal pa stong du chos byas kyang*// rang sems rtogs par mi 'gyur ro// rang sems rang gis ma rtogs na// rtog pas 'khor bar 'khrul ba yi// bde med 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung*// de bas rang sems rang gis blta// brtags pas ma grub de ltar mthong*/ /de mthong rang gi mtshan nyid rtogs// bying 'thibs dbang thob rang so zin// 'bras bu bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub// de ltar spyad do rigs kyi bu// da ltar legs spyad bde ba nyid// mchog lam 'di ni rnyed par dka'// tshe 'di nyid la don grub pa// a ba dhū ti'i spyod pa bya// rigs spyod khyad du 'phags so gsung*// bka' yi ge med pa'i don thog babs su bstan pa'i gdams ngag bla ma rin po che'i zhal gyi gdams pa/ bdag gis ma yengs par gus pas 'thungs nas/ skal ldan gyi don du yi ger cung zad bkod pa 'di/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis dang*// rang gzhan 'khor 'das ma lus pas// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba 'di yis dbang gi rgyal po mchog /rang gi sems la yongs su thob par shog 'di ni bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dmar po zur gsum ba de rlangs tho le phyung ba'i gdams pa yin no// bstan pa'i spyan 'byed gdams ngag gi rtsa ba yin no// 'di med na kun shes gcig la rdugs pa bya ba yin no// 'di gcig shes kun grol bya ba yin/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang dgongs pa gcig pas na dgongs pa gcig pa bya ba yin/ dgongs pa thams cad 'dus pas na/ dgongs 'dus bya ba yin/

gsung 'di la brjod mtha' med pas na/ nam mkha' mtha' med zhes kyang bya/ de ltar rtogs na chos gang la yang mi thogs gsung*/ rje rin po che'i bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad kyi dgongs pa ma lus par dril nas mi brjed pa'i gzungs zhes kyang bya/ gegs sel chen mo zhes kyang bya/ bstan pa'i chings zhes kyang bya/ gdams ngag kun la yod na mkhas pa su yis byed gsung*/ lar 'di lta bu'i gdams ngag nyams su myong ba smra ba kha nas khrag skyug pa bas phangs pa la gsungs nas/ khyed kyi chos skal gyis gsung nas/ gser khang du chig khrid mdzad pa yin/ man ngag 'di ni snod dang ldan pa re re gnyis gnyis tsam gyi spyod yul yin pas/ yar gyi bla ma slob dpon la ma bshad/ bar gyi grogs po dang shag po la ma bshad/ snying phyir ston pa'i mi la ma bshad/ dgos pa med pa yin gsung*/ 'di rang gi slob ma snying dang 'dra ba glo snying brang gsum stod pa byung na ston/ snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus su/ mang po bshad pa dang*/ mang po nyan pa dang*/ mang po sgom pa'i long med pas/ gang zag gi blo'i rim pa dang sbyar la/ las dang po pa la yi ge brgya pa nas bzung ste/ rim pa bzhin 'khrid pa gal che/ dbang bskur ba dang las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bstan pa gal che/ lar chos 'di'i dam tshig tu/ mi dge ba phra zhing phra ba la 'dzem pa dang*/ tshul khrims rin po che dang*/ phyag rgya chen po gnad gcig pas/ 'di nga'i khyad chos bla na med pa yin/ tshul khrims rin po che srog la bab kyang 'bral bar ma byed cig lam la zhugs pa'i gang zag rnams la gdams ngag ral gri chung rgyag tu ston pa gal che/ tshig tu nyung la don du dril ba thos pas grol ba'i gdams ngag yin no// bu la gtad/ thugs la chongs/ thugs kyi dkyil du sbos/ dam tshig la gnas par gyis/ re dga' re dga'/ re skyid re skyid ang gsung*/ gzhi khrid/ lam khrid/ 'bras bu'i khrid/ ma lus pa'i zhal gdams rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/

chos rje rin po che 'bri gung pas/ rin po che la drug pa la gdams pa rdzogs so// rin po che la drug pas/ rin po che rtsa rgya pa la gnang*/ des rin spungs pa la gnang*/ shin tu bka' rgya dam pas gsang bar zhu mdzod cig 'di bris dge bas 'gro ba thams cad kyis// rang gi rig pa dri med mngon gyur nas// ye shes dri med gzhi yi thog tu grol// de yi phrin las nam mkha'i khams mtshungs shog /'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig// / ༄// phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa gser khang sgo bcad ma// na mo rat+na gu ru/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma rin po che de/ 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod du phyag phebs nas tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu bskyangs/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa bdun bzhes pa'i nyin zhag thams cad tshang ba'i nyin par/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig spyan sngar bsags nas/ bka' stsal chen po gsungs/ chos phar la 'dri ba'i tshul du mdzad nas chos 'di rgyu gang las byung rkyen gang las byung gsungs pa la/ la la na re rgyu sems can las byung zer/ la la na re rgyu sangs rgyas las byung zer/ yang sems 'di ma rig pa las byung na/ ma rig pa rang gang las byung gsungs pa la/ thams cad 'dun pa phyogs gcig tu bsgril nas/ ma rig pa sems las byung zer/ khong rnam pa'i lan de la ji lta ba bzhin du mnyes pa ma byung nas/ chos rje nyid dang sku gsung thugs dbyer med pa'i dbon rin po che spyan sngar bos nas gong gi gsung de rnams khong la gsungs pas/ khong gi zhal nas sems bya ba gdod ma nas skye ba med pa/ yod med kyi mtha' dang bral ba sangs rgyas pa yang rang de rang yin/ de las chos byung bar mi 'dod zhus pas/ slob dpon spyan snga'i zhal nas/

de na 'byung ba mi 'dug pas nga la ma bde gsung*/ 'byung dbon gyis sa yod de 'dir mi 'jog gsung*/ de nas chos rje'i spyan snga nas/ bsngo ba zhig mdzad nas thams cad so sor bzhud du bcug go// de nas rgyun gtor ran pa'i dus su/ dbon rin po che/ mkhan rin po che/ slob dpon spyan snga ba rnams spyan sngar bos nas/ gser khang gi sgo bcad nas/ gzhan gcig kyang spyan sngar ma nyan/ de nas bka' stsal gsungs pa/ ༈ /de ring gi chos de khong rnams la rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa zhig mi 'jog pa ci yin gsung*/ khong gi zhal nas da res kyi chos de go bar byed pa la/ rgyu rkyen las byung ba'i rnam par rtog pa dang*/ sems nyid gdod ma nas skye ba med pa/ dbyer med pa zhig tu gyur nas sems kyi phu thag chod pa zhig dgos/ khong rnams la da res kyi chos 'di go bar byed pa shin tu dka' bar 'dug pas ma bzhag pa yin/ spyir rje rin po che lta bu sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon nas/ bu slob dpag tu med pa zhig bskyangs/ 'khor 'das kyi chos ma lus pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ gsung 'di yis thag chod pa dka' bar 'dug de dka' ba tsam du 'phrin las ji snyed cig 'byung ba yang*/ yang dag pa'i don la sems can gdul bya yin min gyis go ba 'di dka' bar 'dug des na do nub kyi dus 'dir chos zhu ba 'am/ zhu mkhan yang 'dzom/ rje'i spyan sngar zhu ba'i dus la yang bab pas/ sngon thog ma med pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ 'khor ba la mtha' yod med cig zhu dgos zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ do nub kyi zhu ba 'di nyams dga'/ zhu mkhan bzang po yang 'dzoms pas 'khor 'das kyi chos ma lus pa do nub sprugs dgos gsungs nas/ sngon thog ma med pa zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan 'di ngo sprod dgos/ 'di ngo ma 'phrod na thog ma med pa rkyang par song nas/ go ba shin du dka' ba 'di khyod bden pa yin/ de la mi che dgu gnyan dgu mang po tshogs kyang*/

sems can dang sangs rgyas gang snga byas pa la rgyu sems can la 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'byung ba yin zer nas sems kyi phu thag ma chod pa'i rtags de rang yin pas/ ma rig pa sems las byung bya ba'i rgyu mtshan 'di yang*/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes la mnga' ma brnyes pas lan pa yin/ spyir yod med kyi mtha' dang bral nas yang dag pa'i don ji lta ba bzhin du gyur na da ltar gyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po 'di 'ong ba'i don med pa la/ sngon byung gi dus su yang zag bcas kyi bde ba chen po dang yang ldan/ gzung 'dzin spros pa dang bral ba'i chos nyid kyang go la/ lam sbyangs pa'i thabs la mkhas kyang*/ shes rab mngon du ma gyur pas/ 'od gsal gyis gzugs med kyi khams na gnas pa'i lha rnams/ 'od gsal de dang dbyer med du gyur pa zhig shar nas yod pa'i dus su/ ya mtha' dang ma mtha' yod na/ de kho na la brten pas chog pa yin te/ de gang yang med pas da lta 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di byung ba yin/ de ya mtha' bya ba yin te/ nyon mongs pa chags sdang 'ba' zhig la longs spyad nas/ mi tshe sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig la skyel ba zhig yod na/ de la brten nas thams cad ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pa'i ye shes sems can thams cad kyi mgon du gyur pa 'gro ba'i bla ma zhig byon na/ da lta ba'i dus su 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di med par byed pa la de gcig pus chog de gnyis gang yang ma 'dzom pa'i dus/ da lta'i dus su khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di bskyed pa yin te/ dus tshod de tsam na sa'i tshod grangs gar gnas snyam na/ sa dgu pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yar la chos sku chen po mngon du ma gyur/ mar la nyon mongs pa chags sdang rag pa dang 'bring po gnyis dang bral tsam pa'i phra zhing phra ba bag la nyal de gnas pa'i gnad kas/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel 'grig nas nang du sems nyid gdod ma nas skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin la/

nyon mongs pa phra zhing phra bas bsgribs nas phyi rol tu nam mkha' stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin la rlung gi phung po chen po chags rgyu byung bas/ de la brten nas chu'i phung po chags/ de la rin chen gser chags/ de la brten nas sa chen 'di chags/ sa'i bcud bsdus pas bdud rtsi zhag tu song*/ de la dri ngad bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung nas/ spyir thams cad gong du ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du phyi spros pa'i rang bzhin dang bral tsam de la yar sangs rgyas bya ba med/ mar 'khor ba zhes bya ba med/ dus de'i med pa zhes bya ba'i rgyu mtshan de lta bu yin/ de'i dus su sngar gyi dri ngad de rnams khong gis tshor rgyu zhig byung nas/ khong thams cad gros byas nas 'di 'dra ba sngan chad byung ma myong zer nas/ 'di'i rgyu ci yin rkyen ci yin/ ji lta ba bzhin du sngon du sus kyang gyur ma nus pas/ de la brten nas pho mo'i shan phyed/ sngar gyi phra zhing phra ba de rang yang dge bar ma slongs shing nyon mongs pa'i las spyad pas 'jig rten pa'i bu dang bu mo gnyis byung*/ khong gnyis la brten te rtsad gcod mkhan cig gdong zhig gis 'thud pas bcud sa zhag rin po che de ma zad kyi bar du thams cad 'khor bar 'khyams/ spyi dang bye brag med par rdzogs pa'i rting ma de nga yin/ nga yong tsam na khong rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du 'dres 'dug nga yi mug shin tu che bar byung nas/ lo bco lnga'i bar du yi mug dang ma bral nas/ de nas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin 'di nas yar 'dren pa la/ cis phan snyam du bsams pa la/ de yang lus ngag yid gsum gtso bor byas nas/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang*/ dag pa'i smon lam 'debs pa dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba dang*/ bzhi po 'di la brten nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam sna zin pa de thugs kyis gzigs pa yin pas/

des na sngon thog ma la 'khor bar khrid mkhan gyi bza' mi gnyis bu phrug gnyis dang bzhi po de/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dus na bdud lhas byin zer ba de/ dus tshod de na khong bza' mi gnyis la log rgyu ma byung nas/ kho blta ru phyin pas/ khong gnyis yar 'khrid ma shes/ yar 'ongs nas thams cad la 'di 'dra snang zhes bsgrag ma shes/ 'khor lnga sde bzang po de lam rim gyis khrid pa'i dang por slob gnyer thams cad rim gyis byas pa yin/ de la brten nas thams cad rim gyis khrid pa yin pas/ da rung ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stong par ma gyur gyi bar lam khrid dgos par 'dug gsung*/ ༈ /de nas yang dbon rin po ches/ ma rig pa 'di sems las byung ma byung bka' stsal zhig gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ khyod la dgos pa med de/ phyi rabs la dgos pa yin pas bya dgos gsung nas/ chu'i phugs gtsang na thams cad gtsang ba dang 'dra bar/ nga'i bka' srol na khyed thams cad bya sa bde/ phyi rabs mang po la yang lam sna myur bar 'ong ba yin gsung nas/ gong du ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du sa dgu pa'i yon tan dang ldan/ de la gnas par nus na'ang*/ 'di las lhag par btsal rgyu med par 'dod/ lar nam yang 'gro sa med par 'dod/ de ni 'dod pa bya ba yin/ zag bcas bde ba chen po'i chags sdang rags pa thams cad dang bral ba'i 'od gsal yang*/ gzugs med khams kyi lha rnams la gnas pa'i 'od gsal de dang dbyer med gcig tu mtshungs pa de la chags pa zer ba yin/ des na 'dod chags de rang ngo ma shes pa dang*/ ma rig pa'i ngang nas gti mug zer ba yin/ des na 'khor ba 'di bskyed pa yin gsung*/ ༈ /yang dbon rin po ches/ chos bya ba 'di gang las byung*/ rgyu mtshan bye brag dang bcas pa zhig zhu dgos zhus pas/ khyod kyi 'dod pa'i thog tu babs nas yod gsung*/ sangs rgyas las ma byung pa yang*/ yang dag pa'i don nam mkha' lta bu la chos kyi sgra med ming med/

mtshon tsam du btags pa med/ gang yang med pa dang bral nas yod pa la/ sems kyi rgyu lam rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la kun gzhi nam mkha' lta bu de dang dbyer med du mtshungs so// 'o na chos 'di gang las byung snyam na/ gong du gsungs pa bzhin du/ 'dod chags la brten nas ma rig pa/ de la rnam par rtog pas 'khor bar skyes/ chos kyang rnam rtog la brten nas byung ba yin/ rnam rtog med na chos med/ rnam rtog byung bas chos kyang byung ba yin gsung*/ ༈ /de la slob dpon spyan snga bas/ ma rig pa'i rgyu 'di sems las 'ong dgos tsam 'dug pa la zhus pas/ dbus gtsang bas khams pa 'di glen zer ba'i thog tu babs par 'dug khyod la yang de'i bag cig 'dug gsung*/ ma rig pa sems las 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan spyan snga nyid nas thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ gser gyi thog tu la cha byugs na gser gyi rang bzhin gar yang ma song yang*/ gser gyi ngo bo mthong rgyu med pa de/ gser gyi skyon yin nam/ la cha'i skyon yin/ gser gyi skyon yin na/ la cha gser gyi nang na 'ong dgos par 'dug des na la cha'i skyon yin pa kho nas/ la cha de rtog par song rtog pa des de bkab pa de go ba min nam gsung*/ shel gong g.ya' dag pa'i rang bzhin la rtsi dmar pos g.yogs na shel gong gi rang bzhin du yod kyang*/ ngo bo mthong rgyu med de shel sgong gi skyon yin nam rtsi'i skyon yin/ shel sgong gi skyon yin na rtsi nang nas 'ong dgos/ des na rtsis phar la g.yogs pas rtsi kho nas rtog bcas su song bas/ rtog pas shel sgong phar la bkab pa yin/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dom dgu yan chod la rlung gis g.yo nus la/ de man chod la 'gul ba gcig kyang med de/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i skyon yin nam/ rlung gi skyon yin/ rgya mtsho'i skyon yin na gting nas g.yo dgos te/ rlung gi skyon yin pa kho nas/

'dom dgu'i yan chod la g.yo nus pa yin gsung*/ de bzhin du rnam rtog gis sems nyid gdod ma nas skye ba med pa de phar la bkab pa yin/ da lta'i dus su nang du mtho dman dpag tu med pa zhig skye ba de yin/ phyi rol du yang las ngan dpag tu med pa zhig 'grub pa 'di yang*/ rnam rtog gi las ngan yin pas/ 'dir spang bya dang gnyen po gnyis las/ spang bya zhes rnam par rtog pa las gzhan zhig med/ gnyen po ni nang gi sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa 'di la blta shes pa zhig dgos/ 'on du lags kyang phyi rol gyi snang ba mang po 'gag dgos pas/ spang bya dang gnyen po gnyis su bya ba yin/ nged rang sgom chen pa rnams kyi dbang du byas na/ dbyer med gcig tu byas nas nyams su len pas/ bu chung la zla ba ston pa dang 'dra'o// de ci 'dra snyam na/ dang po'i dus su mdzug gu bstan de nas je mtho je mtho la btang nas/ lag pa brkyang bas zla ba de mthong ba yin/ sgom chen pa'i nyams len yang de dang khyad med/ gcig pur ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su sdod pa rang la yang*/ sdod sa ri phug la byas nas rgyu 'grul mang po zhig 'ong ba 'di sems kyi skyon yin nam/ lus kyi skyon yin/ sems gdod ma nas skye ba med pa chos kyi sku la g.yo 'gul med/ lus 'byung ba bzhis bsdus kyi phung po'i gzugs su grub pa 'di yang*/ gang yang ma 'gul bar sdod mkhan byas pa de rang yin/ 'o na rgyu 'grul byed mkhan de gang yin snyam na/ de yang rnam par rtog pa yin pas/ rje til+li pa'i zhal nas/ gcig pur sdod cing ring du rgyu// lus med dbang po'i phug na gnas// 'dul bar dka' ba'i sems 'dul byed// gsung ste/ ngas rje phag mo gru pa la zhus/ gzhan thams cad ngas ma 'khums pa la sems 'dul byed/ bya ba 'di da rung bde mo byung zhus pas/ zhal snga nas/ sngon rje mar pas/ rgyud sde'i gsung mang po dper bcad pa la/ de 'dra ba'i sgra skyon du song ba la tshig bzhi sde cig yod gsung*/

phyis phyag rgya chen po'i don skye ba med pa la mngon du gyur nas/ phyi ta ma de la rgya gar nas tshur byon pa'i dus su dpe rnams lho brag na yod pa 'di rnams bcos dgos par 'dug pa'i thugs dgongs btang ba la/ de nas lho brag na mar la byon pa'i dus su mar pa rgyal sras bya ba'i slob ma che shos zhig gis dpe gal che shos de tsho/ lho sum pa'i yul du khyer nas song bas/ des na tshig de tsho ma 'gyur ba yin/ ngas kyang dgon par bsdad pa'i dus tshod du bla ma'i gsung nyams su blangs pa min pa dpe cig kyang bcad pa med/ khyod kyang sgom 'di'i don rang bzhin gyis sngon du gyur nas 'ong bas/ spyir yang rgyu 'bras kyi chos mngon du gyur pa la phal cher zhig dgos pa yin/ skye shi bar do 'di rang la 'byung nges pa khyod yin/ gsung de la brten nas nyams su blangs pas thams cad skad cig ma la 'byung yang 'byung*/ da gcig pur sdod mkhan gang yin snyam na/ gsum tshogs kyi rten 'brel yin gsungs/ ring du rgyu mkhan ni rgyu rkyen las byung ba'i rnam par rtog pa 'di yin/ 'dug rgyu yang rnam par rtog pa 'di yin/ 'di la nan chags su ma byas par song na khyed kyi zhu ba dang 'dra bar gzhan yang ma go ba mang po yong nyen gda' bas/ 'dul mkhan skye ba med pa chos sku yin/ de gnyis kyang dbyer med du byas nas nyams su blangs pa ma gtogs pa dus nam du yang spang blang gi rgyu med/ spyir nga'i chos 'di go dka'/ go ba'i steng la chos thams cad 'di'i thog tu yong bas thams cad khrol nas yong*/ spyi khyab tu ma rig pa'i kha skad 'di yang gong du ma gsungs pa med pas ma chog pa med kyang gzhan la dgos pa yod pas/ nan chags zhig byed dgos gsungs nas rnam rtog ma rig pa las byung*/ ma rig 'dod chags las byung*/ 'dod chags kyi rgyu 'byung ba bzhis bsdus pa yin la/ skye ba med pa chos kyi sku 'di la 'byung ba rnam pa lngas ma gos pa/

dri ma med pa de rang yin*/ 'khor 'das kyi chos dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang nyams su len rgyu lnga ldan las med/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi dus su chos lnga ldan 'di phyi da ba la gsungs pa yin/ de mgon po zla 'od gzhon nus go nas thugs nyams su bzhes pa yin/ de nyan thos rnams kyi thugs su ma shong nas/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo'i thugs su ma shong bas srid pa bar ma do min pa ngos ma 'phrod pa yin/ nga'i chos 'di mang tshod kyi thal cig yin yang*/ bka' gdams kyi dge bshes gdugs thogs pa lnga brgya bas kyang dga' ba yin/ ༈ /yang dbon rin po ches sngon dang po'i 'khor ba byed mkhan gyi lnga po des da lta'i dus su/ gdul bya gar mdzad zhus pas/ spyir thugs rje chen po yang nga yin/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyang nga yin/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dang gzhan gyi gdul bya thams cad pas/ da lta'i gdul bya'i khams che ba yin/ 'on kyang pha de rje btsun spyan ras gzigs yin/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stong par ma gyur gyi bar du bzhugs pa yin/ ma de gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po yin/ de yang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong gi bar du bzhugs pa yin/ las dge sdig gi shan 'byed cing sdod dgos pa yin/ bu mo de yi dwags kyi rgyal mo gzi brjid can yin/ des yi dwags thams cad las ngan pa las bsgyur zhing mtho ris la 'god nus pa yin/ bu de dmyal ba'i a ba glang mgo yin/ sems can gyi las ngan zad pa dang bde ba la 'god nus pa yin/ khong gi cig de lhas byin yin/ lhas byin med na spyir bcom ldan 'das la gdul bya chen po mi 'ong*/ dgos su yang rgyal blon chen po rnams mi thul bas kho la brten nas 'phrin las bzhi mdzad pa yin gsung*/ 'o na kho la bka' bsgo mdzad pa yin nam/ smon lam btab pa yin zhus pas/ smon lam yang btab/ bka' bsgo byas te/ nga dkar por byung na khyod nag por shog

nga dmar por byung na khyod sngon por shog nga ser por byung na khyod khra bor shog gsungs pa dang*/ ming bdud du thogs so// de yan chod kyis sangs rgyas rabs brgya'i gdul bya rdzogs pa yin/ spyir rten gyi gang zag la brten nas chos sgor zhugs pa lta ngo mtshar che ste/ bla ma bzang po 'tshol shes dgos/ rtsa ba'i bla ma su dga' dgas mi yong bas/ phyag rgya chen po don mngon du gyur nas/ gzhan gyi rgyud tshod rang la 'char nus pa zhig dgos/ de yan chod rtsa ba'i bla ma'o// 'dren pa'i bla ma rang la'ang*/ gong ma'i gsung bzhin brjod cing 'khor ba la/ gong nas gong du gsol ba 'debs pa'i gnas bstan nas/ rang gzhan thams cad gong ma'i rjes su 'khrid pa de la 'dren pa'i bla ma'o// dpe tshogs la bskor log byas nas bshad pa brengs se ba de ma gtogs pa man ngag sbreng rgyu gcig kyang med nas gdams pa gzhan thams cad la 'bar cing*/ 'khor rnams rang gcig pu'i rtsar mgo bskor ba de nyan thos kyi slob dpon bya ba yin/ lta spyod de dang ma bral na bskal pa'i bar du sdod dgos/ de nas khong rnam pa gsum po so sor bzhud nas/ gser dngul dang dar yug gi phyag rten phul nas bka' drin che zhing thugs la btags pa'i zhu ba gsol bas/ chos rje'i zhal nas nga las khong khyed la drin che ba yin/ kho med na ngas tshogs pa 'di rnams mi skyong*/ de'i rgyu mtshan gang yin snyam na/ sngon chos rje sgam po pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus su/ rje sgom tshul gyis gdan sa mi yong zer nas/ thams cad kyis phag mo gru pa la gsol ba btab pas/ khong gi lcam sring mos sman drangs pas des rten 'brel 'chug nas gdan sa byed pa ma byung ba yin/ rje phag mo gru pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus su shul der dbon po gcig tsam zhig yod na yang de la brten nas bstan pa yong ba la/ ngam shod lung pa'i mi rnams bla ma dam pa'i bu nga yin zer ba mang yang bdag po yong ba gcig kyang med/

des na kho bo cag kyang khur chen po khur dgos pa byung nas gdan sa chen po'i zhabs tog tu song ba bla ma mnyes pa'i 'phrin las chen po bsgrubs kyang*/ 'or che tsam zhig lta ga la 'ong la/ ma legs pa skad zer nas thams cad kyi tshur la 'jug par 'dug de kho nas kho drin che ba yin/ spyir yang nga kho yin kho nga yin/ sang phod 'phrin las chen po bsgrub dgos pa'i dus tshod cig la kho mnyes por bcug nas/ khyed rnams kyis kyang mthu dpung dang stong grogs byed dgos pa yang yong ba yin no// da res kyi chos 'di dbang po 'bring stod kyi chos yin/ shin tu sba ba gal che bas dper ma bkod cig gsung*/ slob dpon spyan snga bas gzhan la mi ston par rang gcig pus tshags byed par zhu zhus pas/ khyod kyang nga'i bslab bya gdan sa 'di la mig tsig tsig 'dug ste/ khyod rang yang phag mo grur thod pa skyur bar grags gsung*/ tshags byed pa bgyis te/ nga'i chos 'di gya tshom du brjod mi rung gsung*/ ༈ /de nas dbon rin po ches sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i gnas su 'gro ba la ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi bang rim thams cad 'dzegs nas them pa gcig gnyis las ma thon nas ldog pa dang 'dra ba bzhin du/ sngon gyi dus su yang sa dgu pa non pa la brten nas/ bla ma gcig med pas sa bcu pa 'gong ma nus pas/ de la bltas nas da lta'i dus su bla ma dam pa'i drin lan du song na ba spu'i bu ga gcig bskyed pa'i yon tan 'bum gyur gyi char yang mi phod de/ da lta'i dus su ngo bsrung gi zhabs tog kyang 'ong bar dka' bar 'dug zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ sems can la re ba bstan pa cig la brgya stong yang mi 'gro /dpal mgon byed pa bla ma gtso che/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma'i snying pos 'khor lnga brgya la sems bskyed pa mdzad pas/ bslab bya nyams pas skye ba 'di'i 'og rol tu rta lnga brgyar skyes pa la/ khong rta cang shes shig tu skye ba bzhes nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa der ma byon na/

skye ba bco lnga'i bar du der sdod dgos pa yin/ des bcom ldan 'das la brten nas skye ba de'i 'og rol tu ngan song nas thon nas sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i gnas su skyes pa yin/ da lta'i dus 'dir yang chos 'di dang 'brel nas nga la gsol ba 'debs dgos pa yin/ nga mi rabs bco lnga'i bar du song yang rtsa ba'i bla ma byas pas chog pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan gang yin snyam na/ sngon rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la chos slob pa bas kyang bsgom pa gal che ba'i bka' sgo yod pa yin te/ khong thugs shes rab la 'byams pas/ na ning dus tshod du rta chags la skyo sangs la phyin tsam na/ gzod phyag rgya chen po'i zhu gtug byed dgos byung ba yin/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen yer pa bya ba zhig rje phag mo gru pa'i zhal mthong gsung thos kyang rtsa ba'i bla mar byar ma shes nas/ dpal stag lung thang par zhabs tog byas pa la/ phyis 'das mchod kyang khong gi dus mchod byed nas rin po che de la ma btud par 'dug pas/ de'i rten 'brel gyi dbang du byas na/ mgo zhabs nas mar la btags pa yin/ rang yang kha rje dang dbang thang ldog gam chung du 'gro ba yin/ da res kyi chos 'di la yon chen po zhig 'dod pas khyed spun du yod gsung*/ lnga yod zhus pas/ lnga tshigs de nga la phul cig gsung*/ yab yum gyi dbu mdzad thams cad 'bul lo zhus pas/ 'o khyod kyi pha rgan yang 'dir thon par 'dug gsung*/ nga'i chos 'di yang shin tu mngar te khyod kyi yon yang che/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi zas nor snying gsum thams cad 'bul ba bas/ khyod kyi spun zla 'di tshogs 'gyur gyi che ba yin/ spyir phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na nga la dgra ba spu tsam yang med/ rgya nag po gyen du log byang phyogs lho ru song*/ nub shar phyogs su song yang*/ nga la gdul bya cher 'gro ba ma gtogs pa nyams mi nus pa yin gsung*/ ༈ /yang dbon rin po ches/ nyi ma lho nub kyi phyogs 'di ma bde ba zhig byung zhus pas/

ma bde ba de khyod gdul bya che ba'i rtags yin/ slob dpon spyan snga ba la yang khyod kyis kyang kho la nam dgos pa'i dus su rogs dan la 'bungs shig gsung*/ yang lhas byin gyi gdul bya gar yod zhus pas/ phyogs mi gsung nas rgyal po chen po gcig tu yod de yong gsung*/ 'phrin las che chung zhus pas/ bstan pa 'di la nga la 'dud pa mang po zhig 'byung na 'phrin las kyang che ba de rang yin gsung*/ 'di la gab tshig cig yod/ des chog gsung*/ do nub dgong mo 'o cag pha spad kyi chos 'di smar ba yin gsung*/ de nas dge ba'i rtsa ba la bsngo ba mdzad do// phyi de nang gong gi dus su dbon rin po ches/ phyag dpe la bkod nas/ dam chos theg chen gsang sngags 'di// bdud rtsi bcud kyi yang snying yin// ma rig 'khrul pa rtsad nas gcod// 'khor ba mtha' ma yod par go// brgyud pa dpag tu med pa cig /gzhan gyis snang bar byon lags kyang*// ngo bo rang bzhin chos sku yin// mtshan nyid bla ma dam pa yin// dus da res byon pa ngo mtshar yang*// mos gus can la 'bral rgyu med// dal 'byor thob pa'i skye bo rnams// zang zing nor phyir ma 'breng bar// bla ma rje la gsol ba thob// dge ba 'dis mtshon bsod nams kyis// bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// sdug bsngal nad las thar gyur cig /bde skyid gter la spyod pa dang*/ bla med byang chub myur thob shog /chos 'di la dpe gsum las med do// dbon rin po che/ mkhan po rin po che/ spyan snga rin po che dang gsum gyi phyag tu re re yod/ gser khang sgo bcad ma rdzogs so// // ༄// chos khrid gnad bsdus rin chen phreng ba mdzo ra chos khri ma// dpal ldan dus gsum bdag nyid lhun gyi grub pa'i sku// gtsang bdag bde dang rtag par 'gyur ba med pa nyid// mgon po phag mo gru pa bcom ldan 'gro ba'i mgon// skyes chen de la gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'khor bar 'jigs shing thar pa don gnyer ba'i// skyes bu rnams ni rtse gcig gus pas nyon// 'di ni rtsi mchog ma ghi ta zhes pa// nyon mongs dug rnams 'joms shing gso ba'i sman// mgon po phag mo gru pa'i gdams pa mchog

/byang chub sems gsum rin chen rgyal ba'i gter// bslab gsum dri med tshul khrims rin po che// nyams len phyag rgya bzhi dang tshogs pa gsum// stong nyid rgyu 'bras sdom gsum gnad gcig lam// sna rtse bzhi dang bcu chos sum chos kyis// dgra bzhi lam khyer bsre ba gsum po yi// rtsa ba dpa' bo la dor gdams pa yis// gnad nas bzung zhing lam du gtong bar bya// de yi nyams len dmigs pa 'di yin pas// dkon mchog gsum dang byang chub sems// yi dam lha dang bla ma dang*// chos nyid rang bzhin rnam dag pa// dang po rang sems byin gyis brlab// sems dang dbyer med gcig gyur nas// nges pa'i shes pa skyes pa dang*// shes pa'i ngar dang dbal bskyed la// thogs pa med pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// 'phrin las brtsam par bya ba yin// ji srid mi ma yin rnams dang*// khyad par gdug pa can rnams la// tshad med thugs rje chen po bskyed// rang bas gzhan gces skyes tsam na// de dag ma lus thams cad la// gtor ma bkur stis rgyan par bya// de ltar yang yang byas pa yis// 'dod pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma ni// bzang po byung na sbyor ba bya// ngan pa byung na rang nyid kyis// dge sbyor drug 'gyur bya ba yin// lus dang snang ba sems dang gsum// gcig tu bsre ba man ngag yin// de ltar byas pas dus gcig na// rtags dang mtshan ma 'gyur nas mchis// skyes bu dam pa khyed cag gis// thams cad mnyam nyid yangs par gyis// de ltar byas pas 'khor 'das chos// phun tshogs sngon du 'gyur ba yin// rang gi nyams myong mngon rtogs dang*// gong ma'i gsung dang mthun par spyad// gshis dang babs kyi gnas lugs la// mi 'gal nyams len gtso bor gdams// 'dir tshogs bu rnams ji srid par// dam chos 'di dang ma bral na// rang gzhan don gnyis 'byung bar nges// dam chos 'di ni bstan pa na// sde snod gsum gyi snying phyung zhing*// rgyud sde bzhi yi srog kyang yin// dwags po lha rje 'dis dgyes nas// mgon po phag gru chos 'dis tshim// mi kho bos chos 'di rgyas par spel// shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa dar// nged rang pha spad skyid par tshor// zhes rje rin po che 'di nyid kyis/

dpal chen ngad phu ba la sogs nye gnas chen po rnams tshogs nas/ dngos po'i 'bul ba dpag tu med pa byung*/ thang du khri phrag gcig gi tshogs pa bsdus/ tshul shing bzhes/ mdzo ra'i chos khri'i khar phebs/ rnam sbyar gyis rgyal mtshan gsol/ dge 'dun la bca' khrims kyi yi ge bsgrags/ dngos po'i gnang sbyin mdzad/ de nas spyan snga rnams dang dpal ldan ngad phu ba la sogs pa gzhan don nus pa rnams la/ chos 'di'i lam rim dang*/ zab chos kyi gnad rnams bsdus nas gsungs pas/ mdzo ra chos khrid ma'am/ ming gzhan/ chos khrid gnad bsdus rin chen phreng ba zhes bya/ dpal ngad phu ba gtsor gyur la gsungs nas/ phyis 'bri gung gling pas zhib rgyas su byas pa'ang yod ces zer bar snang nas/ rim gyis brgyud pa'i zab chos/ bla ma bzo bo ri khrod pa byams pa/ bla ma ar tse sogs nas brgyud pa'o// // ༄// phyag rgya chen po gser khang sgo bcad ma'i rgyab chos// na mo gu ru/ dang po kun bzang thog med yang thig las// dpal kun tu bzang pos 'di skad gsungs// nga ni 'gro 'dul tshogs spyod legs ston che// byang phyogs kha ba can du nga nyid 'ong*// ming ni rin chen dpal zhes pa// sa bcu'i sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor// 'dus pa khri phrag mang po'i dbus na bzhugs// rigs gsum mgon po la sogs kyi// thugs rgyud bdag gis smin par byed// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen ni// ye thog dang po'i sangs rgyas 'khrul ma myong ba yin gsung ba lags/ sa lu ljang pa'i mdo las/ 'khor ba dang po chags dus lam lnga la gyes nas chags pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di kun tu bzang pos gzigs nas/ thugs mug skyes par gyur pa'i tshe/ rgya mtsho skem par dgongs nas/ dang po yig tshang ka kha bslab// bar du tshul sdom gtsang sbra bslab// mtha' ma theg pa bsam mi khyab// ces pa dang*/ 'khrul ma myong gi sangs rgyas chos rje rin po che yin gsungs pa'i bka' stsal byon pa la/

rje'i zhal nas/ nga ni tha dad ston cing gcig tu gnas// gcig tu gnas shing tha dad ston// ye shes lus can bdag gis ni// thog med dus nas da lta'i bar// mun pa'i khrod du 'khyams ma myong*// bdag ni dam pa'i phar phyin pas// shes bya'i don la mkhas pa yin// gsung*// mkhyen pa'i ye shes la mnga' brnyes pas rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel thams cad thugs su chud pas/ ma rig pa sems las byung ma byung shes pa 'ong ba lags/ don dam me long snying po las// sems nyid don dam 'dres med la// ma rig 'khrul pa'i 'dres kyang med// gsung*/ don dam rnam nges kyi mdo las kyang*// dag pa skyon med sems nyid 'di// nyes skyon ma rig tshogs dang bral// zhes pa dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// zhes pa'i lung dpag tu med pa yod kyang de las go bar mi nus na/ bden par smra ba rnams la go ba gang gis len na 'di ltar lags gsung*/ yang dag pa'i don nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ ma rig pa gcig pa'i don ci la yod/ las kyi rlung glo bur las byung ba dang*/ ye shes kyi rlung dri mas ma gos pa dang gcig par gar yod/ nang du rgyu tshul yang mi gcig ste/ g.yas g.yon gnyis nas rgyu ba las kyi rlung ma rig pa yin/ dbus su rgyu ba'i rlung ni ye shes yin/ zag bcas g.yas g.yon gnyis na rgyu/ zag med dbu ma'i nang nas rgyu ba yin/ rtsa ngos 'dzin gyi rgyu lugs zhal snga nas gsungs pa 'dir ma bkod pa lags/ spyir ni dngul dang dngul rdo lta bu yin te/ dngul rdo las dngul ma byung dngul las dngul rdo ma byung*/ dngul dang dngul rdo mi gcig de bzhin du sems dang ma rig pa gcig las gcig ma byung*/ 'dres pa min te lhan skyes su ma byung*/ ma rig pa sems ma yin/ sems dang ma rig pa gcig pa yang ma yin/ sems la ma rig pa med/ ma rig pa la sems kyi yon tan gcig kyang med/

sems la ni ma rig pa las sems kyang med/ phar phyin nas sems la sems ma mchis ste/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba la sogs/ zhes pa dang*/ sems ni nam mkha' yongs su dwangs pa dang 'dra la/ ma rig pa sa'i drod gsher 'dus pa las na bun sprin dang khug snas mdangs bkab pa dang*/ rgya mtsho'i steng rlung gis g.yos pa dang*/ shel sgong rtsis g.yogs pa dang*/ gser la la chas g.yogs pa dang*/ nyi ma sprin gyis g.yogs pa la sogs pa/ dpe lnga ni zhal snga nas gsungs pas/ glo ba'i rtsa nang nas byung ba ma rig pa'i rlung*/ snying dang srog rtsa 'dres ma nas rgyu ba ye shes kyi rlung*/ glo ba nas rgyu ba'i rlung gis srog rtsa nas rgyu ba'i rlung phar la bkab pas ma rig pa'i ma rig pa yin/ 'byung bzhis stobs bskyed pa ma rig pa yin/ rtsa gnyis po'i rlung gi rgyu lugs kyi ngo sprod des go bar byed pa yin/ spyir rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel thams cad de dang 'dra bar spu ris mi 'dor bar yod pa yin gsung*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ni gcig tu dkar ba rnams ni gcig tu dkar/ gcig du nag pa rnams ni gcig tu nag gsungs pas/ sems nyid gdod ma nas 'dus ma byas pa dri ma med pa nyag gcig pu skyon dang bral ba dang*/ ma rig pa rgyu rkyen las skyes pa gnyis mi gcig go ma go ni mkhyen pa'i ye shes yod med kyi khyad par yin gsung*/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi zhus lan ni/ chos rje rten 'phyag la byon nas gdan sum rim mdzad nas bzhugs pa'i dus su/ skyob pa dang dbang sdud kyi ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas/ rtsa g.yon pa'i nang du dzā byed ye shes kyi rlung nang du chud pas/ phyi rol nas 'jam dbyangs chos zhu ru byon pa la/ gsung rnam dag thugs la rgyun tshugs nas sku zhi ba'i ngo bos chos bstan/ 'jam dbyangs kyis kyang phyag chen gtan la phebs pa yin gsung*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gsung thugs rigs gsum mgon po yin pas/

sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di 'dzin pa'i ring la rigs gsum mgon po sa bcu'i sems dpar bzhugs gsung ba dang*/ sangs rgyas bstan pa ci tsam 'dzin pa tsam gyis sa bcu'i sems dpa' yang shes bya srab tu 'gro ba lags/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo des 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du sems can gyi don byed pa rgyud lung kun na gsal/ dpal 'bri gung pa 'di nyid rnam snang dang po'i rgyud nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yin par gsungs pa dang*/ sa bcu'i sems dpa' rnams kyi bla mar 'byon par gsungs pa dang*/ 'bri sgang rten 'phyag ces bya ba der/ rdo rje 'chang gis 'jam dbyangs kyis sems kyi sgro 'dogs gcod ces pa'i lung yod pa yin/ sku rnam snang dag pa rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par thar pa'o// nub phyogs 'dir ma bde ba cig byung bya ba 'di yang khyod kyi gdul bya yin zhes pa ni/ sngon nub phyogs tsaṇ+ḍa ta zhes bya ba na/ kho bo chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa klu rigs sgron ma zhes bya ba gcig tu skyes pa yin/ de'i dus su khyod dbon rin po che byang chub sems dpa' sgra 'byin dbang phyug yin/ kho ni gong gi rgyal po chen po zhig tu yod ces dge slong 'od kyi sgra bya ba yin/ de'i dus na kho dang khyod la rim gro'i 'brel dang dam tshig cig yod pas kho khyod kyi gdul byar 'ong ba yin/ de yang kho lho nub phyogs su med na khyod kho'i 'gro sa der 'gro dgos yong nas khyod kyang dge slong gi tshul mi thub cing tshe la bar chad yong ba dang*/ nga'i brgyud pa rin po che 'di yang chad pa yin te ma legs pa yin/ de yang kho lho nub phyogs su yod pas legs pa yin gsung*/ da nga'i mi brgyud rin po che 'di dar te/ tha ma sgom ma ra lug can rnams kyis bu chung pang zhing them pa 'dzin pa'ang yong ba yin/ des na ma bde ba de khyod kyi gdul byar 'ong ba yin pas 'di la phrag ma dog dang legs pa yin/

da khyod rang nas bzung ste/ mi rab bcu gcig gam bcu gnyis nas khyod rang gnas 'dir gdul bya'i lhag ma lus pa de skyongs/ de'i dus su ma bde ba de khyod kyi zhabs la gtug cing gdul bya yin/ phyogs bzhi phyogs log kyang nga la dgra med/ gnam chag sa rdib kyang mi rabs drug gi ring la dgra med/ lar dbon rin po che kho la khur chen po 'khur dgos pa'i dus na khyed spyan snga ba/ mkhan po rin po che gnyis pos kyang kho'i grogs dan gyis/ nga'i gnas 'di la chags 'jig 'ong na yang khos lan pa ma yin/ de yang rgyu mtshan zhig gis 'ong ba'i dgos pa yod pas mi sto ba'i rgyu mtshan yod/ de ma byung na gser gyi zam pa 'dra ba'i brgyud pa 'di 'chad pas de byung bas mi sto// spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ dgos nga'i chos brgyud 'dis 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du 'dzin pa yin/ 'di'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ sngon lhas byin gyis smon lam btab pa khyod kyi bstan pa dkar po 'di ngas nag por bzhig par gyur cig byas pa'i tshe/ ngas smon lam btab pa/ khyod sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar rgyas byed cing 'gro ba skyob par shog cig ces smon lam btab pa yin/ yang khos ngas khyod kyi gnas mal la gnod pa dang bshig par gyur cig /ces pa'i tshe/ ngas smon lam btab pa khyod kyi de ltar gyur pa na/ nga'i lha chos mi chos dar zhing khyod 'dul ba dang 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du 'gro ba'i mgon du gyur cig byas pa yod pa yin gsung*/ nub phyogs tsaṇ+ḍa ta na dge slong 'od kyi sgra bya ba des rim 'gror byas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' khyed ni rin che bas khyed kyi 'khor dang khyed rang gi tshab tu skyon yon gang dgos byed par shog bdag dang bdag gi brgyud pa yang dar zhing rgyas pa dbang phyug dang ldan par shog nam zhig khyed kyi zhabs la gtugs nas ni/ mkhyen brtse'i thugs rjes 'dzin par shog

/ces pa'i smon lam yod pa yin gsung*/ nga ku bai ra'i phug na yod pa'i dus su/ lhas sbyin gyis sgyogs 'phangs nas nga'i rkang pa'i mthe bong la sgyogs phog dus yin pa la shing tshal pa zug pa'i dus na/ gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje la sogs pa rnams kyis kho'i sde dang grong khyer bcom pa'i rgyu 'bras kyang yin/ smon lam dang rgyu'i lan chags gnyis ka yin pas re zhig la mi sto// spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mdud pa 'ga' zhig dang*/ dar rgyas ci tsam che na nga'i bstan pa yin/ sangs rgyas bstan pa ci tsam dar ba nga'i bstan pa yin/ lar ma rig pa sems las ma byung ba 'di ma shes pa yang*/ rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel tha dad ma go bas lan pa yin pas/ shes bya'i don la mkhas dgos pa lags/ lar sems nyid 'od gsal chos sku dang*/ rgyu rkyen las skyes pa'i rnam rtog dang gnyis 'dres nas 'od gsal chen po nam mkha' dang 'dra ba zhig byung na go nas 'ong ba yin/ gzhan ni ma go ba bden pa yin/ bag chags kyi sa bon ngan pa zad na sems mngon du gyur pa bya ba yin/ sa bon bzang po kun gzhi de la zer ba ste/ bzang po de ngan pa'i skyon gyis sgrib pa yin/ bsgribs pa la sems can zer ba dang bag chags bzang po'i rkyen dang bral ba la sangs rgyas zer ba yin/ bag chags ngan pa la ma rig pa'i lus zer bas/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ 'khor bar 'khor ba yang lus kyi 'khor los 'khor bya ba yang*/ 'byung ba bzhis gcig gis gcig stobs bskyed nas kun gzhi rnam par dag pa de phar la bsgribs nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rkyen dbang dang 'khor los bskor ba yin pa min nam/ 'byung ba bzhi'i dri ma 'di ci tsam du dag na sems nyid gdod nas dag pa je gsal la 'gro bas 'di go dgos/ des sdig pa mi dge ba dang dkor dang drin la lan dang dam tshig bsrung sdom rnams dgos pa yin/ sems nyid chos sku las dge sdig ma grub kyang rkyen gyi g.yogs pa zhig yin pas/

de sems shing rkyen dang bral dgos pa yin gsung*/ 'byung ba bzhis nyon mongs pa'i stobs bskyed nas bag chags bskyed dbang je che la song nas mngon zhen dang 'dzin pa je che la song bas/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di 'ongs pa yin mod/ sems 'byung thams cad la rig pa/ ma rig pa rkyen skyes 'byung ba bzhi/ des na sngon sangs rgyas dang sems can ma bye ba'i dus der/ rkyen bla ma dam pa dang mjal na bag chags lam du slongs nas sangs rgyas 'ong ba la/ rkyen ngan pa 'byung ba bzhi'i bcud dang phrad pas/ 'khor bar song ba yin/ dang po'i dus der bag chags kyi dri ma dag bya ba de yang blo'i bag chags phra mo zhig yod pa de rang gi ma rig pa de rig pas na/ rgyu rkyen gyi mkhan pos brtag dpyad byed mkhan shes par byas nas bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa gal che ba lags so// // ༄// sgrub pa'i bar chad srung thabs rtsa gsum la brten pa'i gdams pa// bla ma dam pa rnams pa phyag 'tshal lo// lus la brten nas bar chad gsum 'jug phyi rol bdud kyi bar chad dang*/ nang 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi bar chad dang*/ ting nge 'dzin sems kyi bar chad gsum las/ dang po phyi rol bdud kyi bar chad ni/ thun 'go thams cad la shes pa mi bde mal du bsdad tsa na 'gro snying 'dod/ rnam rtog sna tshogs pa 'ong*/ ting nge 'dzin sems kyi bar chad ni/ sgom bzhin phung po ngan du 'gro/ sgom snying mi 'dod pa lus la na tsha bag re 'ong*/ nang 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi bar chad ni/ sgom pa'i dus su rlung dang rlung gi rlung gnyis 'khrugs pas rnam rtog zhe sdang 'ba' zhig 'ong*/ chu'i rlung dang me'i rlung gnyis 'khrugs na/ phyi bas kyang sems can la sred pa che/ de gsum sel ba'i thabs la/ rtsa g.yas pa la brten te/ rgyal po'i gnod pa 'jug shin tu zhe sdang che/ mi thams cad la khro snying 'dod/ dbu ma la brten te/ klu'i gnod pa 'byung*/

shin tu gnyid rmugs shas che/ sgom 'phro la gnyid du 'gro/ g.yon pa la brten te bsen mo'i gnod pa 'jug bud med gar 'dug mig gis bsrung*/ dngos su thig le nyams pa 'ong*/ 'dod chags shas che/ de gsum dag par byed pa'i thabs ni/ rtsa g.yas pa'i nang du rigs lnga yab yum bcu bsgom/ des dag nas 'ong*/ ting nge 'dzin bde gsal mthar thug pa zhig 'ong*/ dbu ma'i nang du bla ma dang yi dam bsgom/ des mi rtog pa skye'o// g.yon pa'i nang du khro bo bcu bsgom/ des dag nas 'ong*/ rtsa gsum la brten pa 'jig rten mgon po 'bri gung pas gsungs so// // ༄// bdud rtsi'i sgrub thabs dang bsten thabs// spyi don gsum pa mi gtsang ba'i rdzas la gzhi lam 'bras bu'o// dang po mi gtsang ba'i rdzas sum cu so gnyis mkha' 'gro ma sum cu so gnyis sam/ bde mchog ltar na dpa' bo nyer bzhi/ bdud rtsi lnga rigs lnga ste/ dri chen rnam par snang mdzad/ dri chu mi bskyod pa/ khu ba rin chen 'byung ldan/ rak+ta 'od dpag med/ 'dus pa don yod grub par ye gdod ma nas gnas so// gnyis pa la lnga ste/ dang po dri chen bsten pa'i thabs dang*/ bcud len dang*/ nad 'don dang*/ nad bsrung ba la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsungs te/ zhang rat+nas mchod rten bzhengs pa'i dus su mi zhig gis rnam snang zhig bzhag pa la/ phyag gis blangs nas spyi bor bzhag ste/ nga'i mchod rten 'byon par 'dug 'di na bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad cig byon nas 'dug gsung ba lta bu dang*/ yang jo bo rje nyin zhig chibs pa zhig la chibs nas byon tsa na rnam snang cig la rak+ta yod pa zhig 'dug pa dang*/ chibs pa bshol te phyag gis blangs nas zhal du gsol ba la/ nye gnas kyis khyed kyang gsang sngags pa lags sam zhus pas/ rnam snang gi dbu la 'od dpag med byon pa los za/ kho bo la rgya gar na gsang sngags pa zer gsung ba lta bu'o// gnyis pa dri chu la'ang*/

nad srung dang bsten thabs la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsungs so// gsum pa thig le ni yon tan thams cad 'byung bas rin chen 'byung ldan zer te/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad thig le las 'byung bas/ bsten thabs dang*/ bsrung thabs dang*/ spel thabs rnams bya'o// bzhi pa rak+ta ni sna khrag la sogs pa'ang ma las thob pa'i thig le dmar po'i cha yin pas/ 'khrul 'khor la sogs pa'i bsrung thabs bya'o// lnga pa 'dus pa ni/ snabs dang*/ mchil ma dang*/ lus kyi rngul la sogs pa thams cad bsrung bar bya'o// mdor na bdud rtsi lnga la tha mal gyi ming nas bos na'ang ltung ba 'byung bas/ rigs lnga'i mtshan nas 'bod pa dang*/ bsrung thabs dang bsten thabs rnams bya'o// gsum pa 'bras bu la gnyis/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug go// dang po ni de ltar ting nge 'dzin la gnad du bsnun cing*/ bdud rtsi lnga'i bcud len byas pas/ rlung sems nang du gnas shing*/ bdud rtsi'i dwangs snyigs phye nas/ dwangs ma lngas 'khor lo lnga khengs pas/ rigs lnga'i zhal mthong ba la sogs pa 'byung ste/ jo bo rjes rigs lnga ser 'jam du gzigs pa dang*/ rje sgam po pas dgyes rdor gyi dkyil 'khor dmar por gzigs pa dang*/ bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor dkar por gzigs pa la sogs pa thams cad nang du bdud rtsi lnga'i dwangs mas 'khor lo lnga khengs pas/ thams cad lha'i mthong snang 'ba' zhig tu 'byung ba yin/ rigs lnga sku mdog lnga 'byung ba'ang 'di'i gnad yin la/ sku mdog 'chol pa dang ma 'chol ba'ang 'di'i gnad do// gnyis pa mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni rigs lnga'i ngo bor sangs rgya'o// // ༄// ri chos bka' rgya ma gsal byed sgron me// rje'i zhal nas/ nad rlung log gis rgyu byas pa yin/ rlung log ni tung tung dang tsab tsub tu song bas lan pas so// ri khrod du rtsol sgrub med pa'i lhug pa gal che/ gang la yang mi brtson de ni byang chub sems dpas brtson// gsung*/

bu ri khrod du tshul khrims rin po che gtsang sing gis bsrung ba gal che/ mi sngun gyi jo mos mi phan/ ri la lha 'dre gdug pa can yid kyi gzugs can pha rol gyi sems kyi 'gyu ba shes pa rnams kyis bltas pas/ gtsang sing gis song nas lha 'dre rnams kyis phyag 'tshal zhing mchod gnas su 'gro ba zhig dgos pa yin/ des na rir phyin nas/ bag yangs zer nas bag med kyi spyod pa mi bya/ nyon mongs dang rnam rtog zhe thag pa nas yid la mi 'gyu bar byas la bsdam/ mi ma yin pa thams cad la gnod pa'i las thams cad spang*/ khyad gsod dang tshig ngan gtan mi smra/ tha na yul dang ri dang sa rdo la yang ngan sems dang khyad gsod dang tshig ngan spong dgos na/ chos byed pa'i grogs po yod pa rnams la lta smos kyang ci dgos/ grogs po gcig la rnam rtog ngan pa zhig skyes pas/ dge sbyor 'phel bdo ba'i dus su zla phyed dge sbyor de nyams nas ma byung*/ de nas bshags pa mang po byas pas phyis gzod sor chud zer ba'i sgom chen 'dug des na ri khrod du mtho dman med pa kun la bsam pa bzang pos yon tan can du bltas na gnas tshad mthong tshad kyi yon tan dang bstod pa tshig snyan pa kho na brjod pa gal che'o// ri khrod kyi yon tan dang bde skyid thams cad rtsa ba dam tshig dang sdom pas bsdams nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kho na las 'byung bas/ 'di la nan tan bya/ gces par bya/ snying por bya/ ang nge go'am/ 'di las med do// lar rtogs pa yod na phyag rgya chen po ni gar yang mi 'gro/ grib ma bzhin du rang la 'khor ba yin/ phyag rgya chen po yod kyang*/ bsrung sdom dang*/ sems gsum po bral na shor ke mang po 'byung bas/ nad dang gnod pa dang sdug bsngal dang gshe skur sna tshogs pa dang*/ mthun rkyen mi rnyed pa dang*/ rnyed kyang dgra rkun dang gtam ngan dang lce 'bab pa sna tshogs pa skyon mang po rgyu 'bras mi bslu bar 'ong nges so// go'am/

de byung dus su rang gi nang gi skyon la bltas pas/ 'di las de byung 'dug snyam nas go ba 'ong ste/ go yang phyis spong ba la ci phan ma gtogs pa/ snga ma'i 'bras bu rnam smin ma zad bar du myong dgos pas/ rang sdug la mis 'phya bar 'gyur bas dang po rang nas gzob pa 'di gnad zab bo// tshod yod pa byed da lta rang nas gzob/ rang srung sdom dang ldan/ sems rgyud byams snying rjes brlan nas/ ye ma bsgom par ri la bsdad na'ang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byin rlabs zhugs nas/ gzhan gyis 'bad rtsol chen po byas pa las dga'/ des na dam tshig dang sdom pa la nan tan bya/ nyes ltung byung na bshags sdom tshad du bskyal/ sems gsum dang ldan par byas nas gzod gsang sngags thabs lam la sogs pa bsgom/ des yon tan zla ba yar ngo bzhin 'phel nas 'gro/ lar ri'i dgos pa 'jig rten gyi bya byed dang bral ba yin pas/ phyin nas khe grags/ rnyed bkur/ yul ris/ phyogs ris/ gnyen ris/ sde ris/ zas gos/ dgon pa'i phyir chags sdang skye ba'i zhing las sogs par 'dug na ni/ bdud yin nges/ phung nges/ 'go ma thon nges/ grung shor nges/ 'bad pa chud zos nges par thag chod do// ri la phyin pa'i chags sdang gi las dang bral/ mnyam nyid kyi ngang la gnas/ cir snang lha sku dang chos sku byams snying rje'i ngang la gnas pa zhig byung na/ don chen po grub pa de rang yin/ bswo tho le rgyal de la zer/ zhal snga nas dgon par gnas pa'i dgos pa shes pa gal che/ dgos pa ni bslab pa gsum la bogs thon pa yin gsung*// // ༄/ /ri khrod 'grims pa gnad kyi chos gsal byed sgron me// na mo rat+na gu ru/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ dang po ri khrod lta bu'am/ gar phyin pa'i sa der 'dug ma zug nas sa ma non na/ phyis ri gang la phyin yang 'dug mi tshugs pas des na dang po gar phyin pa'i sa der/ bde sdug mtho dman sna tshogs la sra btsugs nas bsgom pa gnad che ba yin/

gnas gar 'gro na'ang gzhi bdag de la spyod pa rtsing po byar mi nyan/ rang la mi ma yin gyi gnod pas mi tshugs kyang 'khor la gnod/ sgro skur phog pa la sogs pa 'byung bas spyod pa rtsing po spang dgos pas byams pa dang snying rje bsgom pa gal che/ des gnod pa mi skyel bar phan 'dogs pa yin/ gnas gar 'gro ba'i sa der slebs pa'i dus su/ gzhi bdag gis gtso bo byas pa'i thun 'go la sa phyogs der thugs rje chen por bsgom/ de'i thugs kar yi dam gyi lha bsgom/ de'i thugs kar bla ma dam pa bsgom/ de nas byams pa dang phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag gtor ma phul la khyod kyis stong grogs gyis shig pa'i bka' bsgo bya/ de ni sbyor ba'i chos so// dngos gzhi nyams su blang ba'i lugs ni/ gegs sel ba dang bogs thon pa'i sgo nas nyams su len pa zhig dgos te/ lnga ldan gyis nyams su len pa'i dus su dmigs pa gang la 'dug pa'i dus su/ phyi'i snang ba gzugs sdug mi sdug dang*/ sgra snyan pa dang mi snyan pa dang*/ nang gi rnam par rtog pa dga' mi dga' ba la sogs pa byung ba'i dus su/ de rnams kyi rjes su mi 'brang bar dmigs pa de rang so der gnas pa gal che ba yin/ de la phyi'i snang ba dang nang gi rnam par rtog pa gang byung ba'i dus su/ de rnams kyi rjes su mi 'brang bar dmigs pa de rang so der gnas pa gal che ba yin/ de la phyi'i snang ba dang nang gi rnam par rtog pa gang byung ba'i dus su rang gi dmigs pa gang la 'dug bltas la/ dmigs pa de yi dam lha lta bu la 'dug na/ yi dam gyi lha gsal rgyu mi 'dug kyang dmigs pa mi spo bar yi dam rang gi thog tu gnad du bsnun pa gal che/ gdams ngag 'di yod na dngos grub thob pa la tshegs med pa yin/ des na bud med lta bu zhig gi bsam pa byung na de la yid shor nas dmigs pa 'khyer na/ de'i nub mo bsen mor 'ongs nas bar du gcod pa yin/
