rje btsun khro bo'i rgyal po'am/ phyag na rdo rje'am/ bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang rdo rje dang*/ bcom ldan 'das 'jigs byed la sogs pa zhe sdang de'i rigs su gyur nas zhe sdang can 'dul ba'i gnyen por yong*/ gti mug las sangs rgyas pa'i dus su yang/ bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad lta bu gyur nas/ sems can gti mug can thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god par yong ngo*// skyes pa'i yul rigs mi 'gyur ba ni/ sangs rgyas pa'i dus yang yul de rang gi 'khor gyi gtso bor gyur nas/ sems can gyi don byed pa la phan pa dang bde ba 'grub pa'o// bzhi pa bla ma dam pa bsgoms pa'i khyad par gyi chos ni/ bla ma dam pa'i thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'o// lnga pa phyag rgya chen po bsgoms pa'i phan yon gyi chos ni thams cad dbang du 'du ba'o// de la nyon mongs pa lam du byed pa lam gtong nas phyag rgya chen po'i bar la lnga ldan du yod/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la sems bskyed nas bsngo ba yan chad la lnga ldan du yong*/ bsngo ba thun mong gi chos bya ba yin/ tshan cig dge ba'i rtsa ba lam du gtong zer ba yod de/ de tsug min dge ba'i rtsa ba lam gtong gi sgra mi 'jug ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gong nas gong du bogs 'don pa yin/ de yang sems bskyed kyis bogs 'don te/ dge ba'i bsam pa bskyed pa dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis don du sems bskyed nas dus ring thung rnam pa gsum du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol bas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gong nas gong du bogs 'don 'ong ba yin no// nyon mongs pa thams cad la dang po lam du gtong ba nas bsngo ba yan chad tshar bar nyams su blangs pas nyon mongs pa'i dri ma de dag pa dang*/ de dang bral bas gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ting nge 'dzin skye ba dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu nyon mongs de'i rigs can 'dul ba'i gnyen por yong ba gong du snyan du gsol ba bzhin yin gsungs/

rdo rje 'chang chen ma yi gsung*// zab cing rgya che tshogs su byon// bzang po dbang du bsdu ba dang*// ngan pa lam du btang ba yis// skyon dag yon tan 'gyur ba'i gnad// bdag gis cung zad zin pa bris// nor 'khrul byung na bla ma yi dam dang*// dpa' bo'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol// dge ba 'di dang rang gzhan rang gzhan 'khor 'das kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge des// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can ma lus pa/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog// / ༄// sum chos kyi khrid lo rgyus dang bcas pa// oṃ swasti// bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ gdams pa 'di la thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis yin bgyi ba gsungs/ de la thun mong ba'i dbang du byas na rten gyi gang zag gang yin pa dang gcig des nyams su blang ba'i chos gang yin pa dang gnyis/ tshul lam thabs ji ltar nyams su blang ba dang gsum/ nyams su blangs pas sgrib pa ji tsam 'dag pa dang bzhi/ yon tan gang skye ba dang lnga lags/ ༈ dang po/ de la rten gyi gang zag ni/ brtson 'grus che la yid thung ba rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi lta bu yin pas/ rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi sku 'khor dang bcas pas u rgyan gyi pho brang gi yang thog tu bzhugs pa lags par gda'/ de'i dus su yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khor lnga brgya dang bcas pa ri bo gangs can la byon pa'i tshur lam pho brang gi steng gi nam mkha' la byon pa rgyal pos mthong nas/ nang blon zhig la dris pas/ 'di sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku 'khor dang bcas pa yin zhus pas/ 'o na gdugs tshod la spyan drangs na 'byon nam dris pas/ blon po na re gdugs tshod bshams nas gsol ba btab na 'byon byas pas/ de nas gdugs tshod bshams nas gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan sku 'khor dang bcas pa byon pa la/ gdugs tshod drangs pa yin par 'dug de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos gsungs pas/

rgyal po na re/ lum bi'i tshal ni nyams dga' bar// wa nyid seng ger gyur kyang ni// 'dod pa spangs pa'i thar pa dag// gau'u tam nam yang mi 'tshal lo// bgyi ba zer ba yin par 'dug de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po de 'dul ba'i dus la babs par mkhyen nas thub pa chen po nyid skad cig gis zhe sdang rdo rjer mdzad/ 'khor rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su mdzad/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag gnang nas/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas nyams su blangs pas/ grub pa brnyes nas 'khor dang bcas pa mkha' spyod du gshegs nas/ o rgyan lan cig stongs par mdzad pa yin par gda'/ ༈ gnyis pa/ de lta bu'i brtson 'grus che la yid thung ba'i rten gyi gang zag des/ nyams su blang rgyu'i chos ni spyir rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa bzhi/ de'i nang nas kyang khyad par du 'phags pa/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud/ thabs shes rab rnam pa gnyis sam byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis dbyer med par nyams su len pa lags/ ༈ gsum pa/ tshul lam thabs ji ltar nyams su len pa ni/ phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas nyams su len pa yin pas/ de la phyi ltar rtsi na/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa bcom ldan zhe sdang rdo rje/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa o rgyan gyi grong khyer/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa/ chos phun sum tshogs pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud/ dus phun sum tshogs pa snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus dang rnam pa lnga lags/ nang ltar rtsi na/ rang nyid yi dam gyi lhar sgom pa ston pa phun sum tshogs pa/ rang gi lus la yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi rang bzhin gyis tshang bar gnas pa gnas phun sum tshogs pa/ gnas de rnams na dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rtsa dang yi ge'i tshul du gnas pa 'khor phun sum tshogs pa/ nyon mongs pa nam skyes pa'i dus su gdams ngag gis nyams su len pa dus phun sum tshogs pa/

de ltar nyams su blangs pa la brten nas dga' ba bzhi'i nyams myong 'char ba chos phun sum tshogs pa bgyi ba dang rnam pa lnga yin/ chos de skye bar byed pa la mthun pa'i rkyen rnam pa lnga yin pas/ de la gnas ni yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa'am/ dbang phyug chen po yab yum gyi rten yod pa'i sar nyams su blangs pas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten 'brel 'grig nas/ nang du ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye ba dang*/ gnad du 'gro ba 'ong ba lags/ rdzas ni bcud len da byid kyi rnam pa khams byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le 'phel ba dang rgyas pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa rnams yin/ dus ni nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa drag po nam skyes pa'i dus su nyams su len pa yin/ grogs ni chags lam pa yin na/ las kyi phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yin la/ grol lam pa yin na/ rang gi mthun rkyen la sogs pa sgrub pa'i nye gnas yid dang mthun pa rnams yin la/ ting nge 'dzin ni bskyed pa'i rim pa bdag byin gyis brlab pa lha yab yum zhal sbyor gyi rnam par bsgom pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa thabs lam gtum mo 'am/ sum khrid la sogs pa nyams su blangs pas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten 'brel 'grig nas bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye bar 'ong ba yin/ de'i dus su gdams ngag dang snying rus gnyis 'dzom dgos pa yin/ de la snying rus med na gdams ngag yod kyang nyams su mi lon/ gdams ngag med na snying rus yod kyang nyams su blang rgyu med/ des na gdams ngag dang snying rus gnyis 'dzom par byas nas nyams su blangs pa'i dus su zag bcas kyi dga' ba rnam pa bzhi po de/ zag med kyi dga' ba bzhir 'gyur nas/ rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngo 'phrod nas 'ong ba yin/ ༈ bzhi pa/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas sgrib pa ji tsam zhig 'dag na/ spyir sgrib pa gsum ka 'dag/ khyad par du shes bya'i sgrib pa 'dag

༈ /lnga pa/ yon tan gang 'thob na sku rnam pa gsum dbyer med pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po 'thob pa yin gsungs/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas bde ba chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye/ de ltar skyes pa'i dus su mi brtan pa'i dogs pa yod pa la/ de brtan par byed pa'i gdams ngag dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ gnyis pa khyad par gyi chos thun mong ma yin pa rnam pa gsum po 'di las zab pa med pa yin/dam tshig ni nyon mongs pa lam du gtong ba'i man ngag bde chen byang chub sems kyi man ngag/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi man ngag go/ ('di bka' rgya ma yin ) de nyams su ji ltar len snyam na/ chags pa'i rtog pa tshan chen po skyes pa'i dus su 'dzin pa dang*/ 'grems pa dang*/ brtan par byed pa rnam pa gsum yin/ 'o na ji ltar 'dzin snyam na/ nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa nam skyes pa'i dus su phag sna'i gtun bu'am/ gnyen pos btsan chod du byas nas lam du gtong ba shin tu gal che ba yin/ de'ang kha la yam gyis mi phan pa yin pas/ zhe thag pa snying khong rus pa'i gting nas/ bdag gi nyon mongs pa 'dis bdag dang khams gsum gyis sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad 'dag par gyur cig ces shes rab snying po tshar cig 'don pa'i bar tsam du byas pas shes pa tshim pa dang*/ rkang chogs pa zhig 'ong*/ de ltar lam du btang bas/ nyon mongs pa de dang bral nas gnas der zin par 'ong ba lags/ de ltar gnas der zin par song yang*/ ma khrems par song na nad dam/ skyon du 'gyur ba yin pas 'grems pa gal shin tu che ba yin/ 'o na ji ltar du 'grems snyam na byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gal shin tu che ba yin pas/ rang nyid nyon mongs pa skyes pa'i yul des gtso byas pa'i rang gzhan thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya ba'i ched du sems bskyed pas/ sems de yang sngar dang mi 'dra ba tshan chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye bar 'ong ba yin/

de ltar sems bskyed pas lus byang chub kyi rang gzugs 'ong ba de la bde chen byang chub kyi sems zhes bgyi ba yin/ zhe sdang lam du btang nas sems bskyed pa gal che/ gti mug lam du btang nas sems bskyed pa la rtog med byang chub kyi sems gsung ba yin/ de nas byang chub kyi sems rin po che las byung ba'i bskyed pa'i rim pa yi dam gyi lha rgyan cha lugs ma tshang ba med pa shin tu gsal ba bsgom mo// de ltar bsgoms pas spyi bo'i gtsug man chad/ rkang pa'i mthil yan chad ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad thams cad du khrems nas 'ong ba yin/ de nas bla ma dam pa dang phyag rgya chen po bsgoms pas shin tu brtan par 'ong ba lags/ de'i rgyu mtshan rtsa rlung thig le la sogs pa thams cad rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po de las mi gzhan par 'ong ba lags/ de nas rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba bgyid pa lags/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas tshe cig gis bla na med pa'i byang chub tshegs med par thob pa lags/ des na rje rin po che'i khyad par gyi chos 'di las zab pa med pa yin pas/ de ltar nyams su len pa dang gnad du bsnun par zhu 'tshal/ de la sngon gyi dus su 'di nyams su len pa'i thabs la gdams ngag gi rigs thams cad thugs nyams su ma bzhes pa tsam med pa la gang gis kyang phan pa ma byung*/ drag shos zhig gis mas yar log pa'i dus su yas mar shangs nas mtshal byon pa byung*/ de las drag pa ma byung/ des na 'di nyams su len pa la/ spyan mnga' nyid nas thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i khyad par bgyi chos 'di las zab pa med pa yin/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas skyon thams cad 'dag pa dang*/ yon tan thams cad rgyud la skye ba la tshogs med pa yin pas/ de ltar du shes par mdzad 'tshal/// / ༄// zab chos 'khor lo bzhi ma'i zur 'debs// chos rje rin po ches shar dwags lha sgam por byon nas/ gdan sa 'dir byon pa la dwags po nga rab gangs ra mgul na yar byon pa'i dus su/

lha rje sman nag bgyi ba des mdzo dkar po zhig bzhon nas yong bas/ mo ma zhig gis 'dir rgyal 'gong byung zer/ sa gtor rdo gtor byas pa la/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ 'di kun la phyogs re'i tig tig 'dug 'o de tsug yod pa yin gsungs/ yer pa zhang btsun bgyi ba la khams gzhi byung ba la/ thams cad kyis mtshams gyis zer ba la/ nga de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba'i dge slong zhig yin pa la mtshams mi gcod/ phan yang skyabs 'gro byed/ ma phan yang skyabs 'gro byed zer nas dkon mchog gsum la rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pas/ dus tshod cig na/ rang dbang med pa'i dad pa skyes nas/ bdag yer pa zhang btsun zhes bgyi ba/ sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// chos don dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// dge 'dun 'phags pa'i dge 'dun phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o zer ba'i dus na spyi bo yar klu chen po zangs kyis thon nas/ bdag gi ming ni zur phud rgyu 'dal zhes bgyi ba yang*/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o zer nas song skad/ de nas yer ba zhang btsun gyi mdze sangs kyis sos par 'dug gnyis pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen khams pa lud pa la khams gzhi byung nas khong dge bsnyen lags par gda' bas/ sngar zhang btsun gyi skad zer nas/ skyabs 'gro byas pas/ nub cig rmi lam na klu zhig bud nas thu ba na yod pa de/ dge bshes ston pas/ re ral gyi ral gur zhig gon nas byung*/ phu dung kha bo che de'i nang du klu de bcug nas khyer ba rmis pas/ khams bde sangs kyis phan pa lags par gda'/ skyes bu de kun la 'di lta bu'i gdams ngag ni med/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rjes su nges pa tsam yin la de lta bu byung na 'di lta bu'i gdams ngag nyams su blangs pas ci'i phyir 'bras bu mi 'byung ste 'byung bas 'bad 'bungs thon/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po bzhin du rtul bzhugs de lta bu yod na lo tsā rin chen bzang po min yang mkha' spyod la 'gro/

zla ba re re gnyis gnyis kyis mkha' spyod la 'gro ba dang*/ dngos grub thob pa yang 'byung gsung*/ gsum pa air jo gdan zla mdzes bgyi ba byung nas/ khos nyin gcig bsam pa la 'khor ba yid byung nas bdag dus thams cad du dge slong sdom pa rin chen dang ldan par bya'o// de yang skye ba thams cad du dge slong du bya snyam nas 'dug pas de'i rjes la bdag sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du dge slong gi sdom pa de bsrung bar gyur cig ces dam bca' brtan po zhig skyes pa'i tshe/ mdun du dpal ye shes kyi mgon po/ sku la me ri dmar nag tu 'bar ba/ zhal khro gnyer du bcas pa dang*/ dpal lha mo sku la me 'bar ba zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas pa gnyis byon nas/ lha mo'i zhal nas ming po'i bsam pa de bzang*/ khyod kyi yon bdag ngas bya zer nas/ skyes bu kun spyod pa rtsings nas ngan pa byed na chos skyong des de bsrung ste mi mchi/ chos skyong chos skyong yin mod/ 'dir yang ma mgon gnyis la 'gro 'ong yod pa ma yin/ bsam pa bzang po de skyes pas de lta bu 'byung ba yin mod/ de ltar du go bar byed dgos/ de yang chos rje rin po che e chung sgom phug tu lo bdun bzhugs pas/ drug thal/ bdun gyi ngo mthong ba las/ smin mtshams yan chad du ma shor ba ni dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i ring srel zhig dbu la bzhugs pas de'i byin rlabs su gda' ste/ ri khrod du sdod pa la rten yang gal che bar gda' gsungs/ de'i dus na snyung gzhi de la thams cad kyi skyug bro bar bltas nas/ skad re gtong ba la yang bros nas 'gro bar 'dug pas/ da ni ma nyan 'dug ci bya'am dgongs nas thugs dgongs mang po btang ba las/ 'gro sa yang mi gda'/ ba lu chags pa gcig za 'og zi khyim thong cha gcig yod na rten 'brel gyis bsnyungs dwangs yong bar dgongs nas/ bla ma yal la phrin mang du btang yang tha ma ba lu mes 'tshig 'phro zhig dang*/

za 'og rnying pa mthong cha cig 'ong dang thugs chad/ nang cig thugs dgongs btang bas nyi ma shar rting/ brag dkar la khar 'gro la rdza dong zhig brus la de'i nang du zhugs nas/ sku srog chos kyis bcad la 'pho ba mdzad dgongs nas gshegs pa la/ gnam sgo 'og ma'i steng du phyin tsam na/ dbu sngas na chos rje phag mo gru pa'i sku gcig dang*/ jo bo thugs rje chen po'i sku gcig bzhugs pa dran pas/ nga la khams gzhi byung ba bla ma dang yi dam gyis ma lan/ phyi phyag byed dgos dgongs nas/ rings sha dang bred thabs la yar log ste/ 'di sngas na brten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gnyis par gda'/ de nas jo bo dang bla ma la mar me mdzad kyin brkyang phyag gsum btsal ba'i phyi ma de'i dus su snying rje sprig pa cung zad tsam zhig byung ba la/ sngags pa'i rgyud du song bas chos la thugs rus che bas/ snying rje ngos zin nas/ de la long ba glang gzhug tu mdzad/ shi med ko med du bsgom pas der snying rje stobs cher song nas/ thugs dgongs la bdag da ltar bsnyung nad 'di lta bu yod kyang mi lus rin chen thob/ bla ma sangs rgyas dang mjal/ rtogs pa dang yon tan du ma mnga'/ rigs drug tu skyes pa rnams la yang sdug bsngal 'di lta bu yod dgongs nas tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po las skyes pa'i byang chub kyi sems yang yang skyes nas/ lar mi lus la rgyal po lta bu bzhugs pa'i dus na 'tshang re 'jug par gda' ste/ dang po zhabs kyi mdzug gu rnams nas byi ba mang po bud nas song*/ de'i rjes la khong pa'i nang nas mdzo g.yag la sogs pa rta bong dang spyang ki la sogs pa mang po bud nas song*/ de'i rjes la gzod rgyal po de bud nas song*/ de'i rjes la zhabs na mar klu ril ril 'jigs su rung ba che ba/ rtsub pa mgo bo la rmug pa thul lu lu byed pa bud de phyed tsam thon pa'i dus nas/ ldog gis dogs nas snying rje rgyun bsrings pas/

lung pa de gang ba bud nas song*/ dpyid kyi dus snga mo yin pa la thog na tshur 'brug tshag tshag pa grags nas ser ba zhig kyang bab skad/ der sku lus sngar dang mi 'dra ba shin tu bde ba zhig byung*/ e bden snyam nas bzhengs nas bltas pas sngar bas kyang lus sems thams cad bde ba zhig byung*/ dgyes drags pas phyi ru skyong bsangs byed pa'i sa steng shig yod par byon pas 'phags ma sgrol ma bdun zhal gzigs/ de rnams spyi bo nas sku lus la bstim nas nang du byon/ nyi ma dgong kha grong ba lang 'dzud pa'i dus su song nas 'dug gzim sa'i logs la rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal gzigs/ theg pa chen po'i chos ma lus pa thugs la bkra lam gyis shar/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad zung 'jug 'ba' zhig tu rtogs/ de phyin chad thun cig kyang sgom ma myong*/ sgom dgos kyang ma dgos/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rten 'brel du thugs su chud/ thugs dgongs kyi ba lu me tog khra chi le ba dang*/ za 'og zi khyim yang gzod byung*/ bla ma yal gyis sngar ma thos kyang sha chang po bsnyen bkur bskyal/ bram ze chen po phug tu byon dbang bskur zhes pa'i grags pa chen po yang byung*/ mdor na 'jig rten 'di na slob dpon bir+wa pa che ste/ de bas kyang lhag pa rdo rje 'chang chen por gyur gsungs/ des na 'di lta bu'i snying rje tshad med pa dgos la/ de las skyes pa'i byang chub kyi sems skyes pa yin te/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa skye dgos pa yin te/ stobs su gyur nas yon tan dpag tu med pa skye ba yin gsungs so// // ༄// sum chos 'khor lo ma dge bshes skal ldan la gdams pa// mnyam med bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// mchod pa'i yo byad rnams shoms shig byas la/ mchod gtor bshams pa dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi don du gtor ma byin gyis rlob pa dang*/

tshogs byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos gnang bar zhu 'tshal zhes lan gsum phyag 'tshal zhu/ de nas tshogs gzhung nas bshad pa bzhin bya/ skabs 'dir sems bskyed bya/ de la theg pa chen po sngags kyi lugs kyi rdo rje'i lus gtso bor ston par byed pa yin/ de zab cing gnyan pa yin/ rdo rje'i lus 'di la rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ de tshur bsdus na drug cu rtsa bzhi/ de bsdus pas rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis/ de yang bsdus na rtsa gsum/ 'khor lo bzhir gnas/'dir tshogs 'khor dgos par gsung*/ rtsa gsum ni/ ra la nā/ ra sa nā/ dhu tī'o// 'khor lo bzhi ni/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags bskyed/ rlung me rlung*/ gdon mo gdon/ nad tshad pa bskyed par byed do// snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo la rtsa 'dab ma brgyad/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang*/ rlung chu rlung dal ba can/ gdon pho gdon/ nad rlung nad bskyed par byed/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo la rtsa 'dab ma bcu drug nyon mongs pa phrag dog bskyed par byed/ rlung rlung gi rlung*/ gdon klu btsan/ nad glo bur ba bskyed par byed do// spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo la rtsa 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis/ nyon mongs pa gti mug rlung sa'i rlung*/ gdon sa bdag nad bad kan nam mdze bskyed/ de'ang phyi nang thams cad gnad gcig pa las/ nang na ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du/ phyi rol tu'ang de ltar gnas pa yin/ de'ang dgyes mdzad las/ phyi rol de bzhin nang de bzhin// bgyi ba gsungs/ nang ma mthong bas phyi rol mi mthong*/ gsung bas/ de gdod ma nas gcig tu gnas pa yin/ ji ltar gnas snyam na/ nang bsam pa'i rten 'brel du gnas/ nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba gti mug bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di/ mkhregs pa dang spang dka' bas/ de las skyes pa'i rten 'brel du nang sha dang rus pa mkhregs pa yin/

phyi'i rten 'brel du sa rdo rnams mkhregs pa yin/ rdo rje'i lus kyi nang stong par yod pas/ phyi rol gyi ri sul dang lung pa thams cad stong par yod pa yin/ rdo rje'i lus la 'khor lo mtho dman du yod pas/ phyi rol gyi dngos po thams cad kyang mtho dman du yod pa yin/ khams spyi bo nas thur du 'bab pas/ chu rnams thur du 'bab pa yin/ nang du gtum mo'i me gyen la 'bar bas/ phyi'i me thams cad gyen la 'bar ba yin/ g.yon pa'i rtsa nang na/ ma las thob pa'i thig le dmar po brtan pas/ phyi'i nyi ma 'phel 'grib med pa yin/ g.yas kyi rtsa nang na/ pha las thob pa'i thig le dkar po mi brtan pas/ phyi'i zla ba la 'phel 'grib 'ong ba yin/ rtsa de las phra ba rnams yod pas/ phyi rol tu gza' chen rnams 'ong ba yin/ rtsa shin tu phra ba rnams yod pas/ skar phran rnams 'ong ba yin/ rtsa rags par khams rgyu bas/ phyi rol tu chu bo chen po rnams byung ba yin/ rtsa phran rnams su khams rgyu bas/ phyi rol tu chu phran rnams byung ba yin/ phra ba 'ga' re la khams mi gnas pa yod pas/ phyi rol tu lung pa skam po chu med pa rnams byung ba yin/ shin tu khams phra ba gnas pas/ phyi rol tu chu mig dang*/ ltengs ka rnams byung ba yin/ rtsa re re'i sna la spu re re yod pas/ phyi rol tu rtsi shing byung ba yin/ nang gi rtsa rnams gtso 'khor du yod pas/ phyi'i 'byung ba rnams gtso 'khor du yod/ sems can thams cad kyang gtso 'khor/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyang gtso 'khor du yod pa yin/ rlung kha dog lnga yod pas/ phyi'i rin po che la sogs pa 'byung ba thams cad kyang kha dog lngar 'ong ba yin/ sems can thams cad kyang kha dog rnam pa lnga/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyang sku mdog lngar 'ong ba yin/ nang na so so'i rtsa yig yod pas/ phyir yang 'gro ba rigs drug 'ong ba yin/ lus kun la khyab pa rlung yin pas/ phyi rol du'ang rlung thams cad la rgyu ba yin/

don snying rnams so sor ma 'dres pa bzhin phyi'i snang ba de ltar du 'ong ba yin/ nang gi snod rnams kha gyen la blta ba bzhin du phyi'i snod rnams kyang kha gyen la 'ong ba yin/ mdor na thams cad rten 'brel du tshogs pa gcig tu go dgos/ nang na yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod pas phyi rol tu'ang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi byung ba yin/ nang na dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bzhugs pas/ phyi rol tu'ang bzhugs pa yin/ nang na mi gtsang ba'i rdzas sum cu rtsa gnyis yod pas/ phyir yang mkha' 'gro ma sum cu rtsa gnyis bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams 'jigs shing btsog pa yin/ gsum tshan re la gnang ba'i/ chos thun dang po'o// //yang skabs 'dir sems bskyed bya/ de la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi po 'di babs kyis gnas pa yin/ babs thog tu sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang gsungs pa yin/ bla ma gong ma'i bzhed pa yin/ de la gang zag la la'i bzhed pas/ rtsa rlung thig le 'di rnams zab par bzhed par 'dug ste/ 'di zab pa min/ zab na sems can dmyal ba la'ang yod/ dud 'gro la'ang yod/ 'o na gang zab na/ bsam pa bzang po byang chub kyi sems zab pa yin/ spyir rtsa rlung thig le gsum po 'di lung ma bstan yin/ tha mal pa'i dus na nyon mongs pa'i tshogs kyis bsgyur bas/ nyon mongs pa 'ba' zhig gi rtsa rlung thig ler 'gyur/ rtsa dang 'khor lor slar stobs bskyed par byed/ nyon mongs pa'i rtsa rlung de rnams kyis 'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtsho bskyed par byed/ khyad par du 'khor lo bzhi la brten nas mdze 'di 'byung bar go// de 'byung bar rgyu rkyen gnyis yin te/ rgyu nyon mongs pa zhe sdang skyes pa'i nad dang gdon dang/ mdze nad drag po la sogs pa thams cad kyang rtsa rlung thig les bskyed par byed do// ji ltar skye na/ tshe snga ma nas las ngan bsags pa'i rnam par smin pa las grub pa'i las ngan gyi rlung mi dge ba las grub pa'i rlung bya ba zhig lus kyi smad rkang pa'i mthil du gnas pa yin/

de la rkyen tshe 'dir dam tshig nyams pa'am/ sdig pa'am/ sdom pa nyams pa'am/ byang chub sems dpa' bkrongs pa'am/ stag gzig bsad pa dang*/ yul gnyan pa'i mdun du mi gtsang ba dor bas 'byung ba yin/ tshe 'dir mi dge ba byas pa'i nyon mongs pa bskyed nas/ rlung gyen la zhugs nas mi dge ba 'ba' zhig 'ong ba yin/ rlung de ji tsam mthor song ba tsam gyis/ nyes pa cher 'gro ba yin/ dper na lho nub kyi srin po dang 'dra/ tshur la ji tsam 'chugs kyis nyes pa cher 'gro bas kha gnon dgos pa bzhin du las kyi rlung de'ang kha gnon dgos pa yin pas/ dmigs pa dma' dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/ rkang mthil gyi rlung gyen la log pa tsam gyis/ nyon mongs pa chen po skye/ dmigs pa dma' dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no// tshe snga ma'i las ngan gyi rlung zhig der gnas pa de'i rkyen tshe 'dir mi dge ba byas pas/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang bskyed pa'i rlung gyen du log nas gsang gnas su slebs pa'i dus su 'dod chags chen po skye/ lus grang 'brum mam drod 'du ba 'ong*/ de nas las kyi rlung de lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor zhugs pas/ phyi'i rten 'brel du rang bsen mos dbang byas/ de sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mkhyen/ lha dang drang srong dang*/ tha na mo mas kyang shes nas 'ong*/ nang rten 'brel du rang la chags pa drag po skyes pas/ nad mkhris pa'am tshad nad drag po 'byung*/ gsang ba rten 'brel 'khor lo de nyid do// de'i dus su pha rol tu phyin pa'i dbang du byas na/ nyon mongs pa'i rlung de chom dgos/ sngags kyi dbang du byas na phyag rgya bzhis bsdam dgos/ ma bsdam na lo gsum nas snying gar zhugs/ phyi rten 'brel du bsen mos dbang byas rgyal 'gong la gtad/ rgyal 'gong gis dbang byas/ nang rten 'brel zhe sdang drag po skye/ nad snying rlung dang gzer drag po 'byung*/ mdor na stod nad drag po 'byung*/

gsang ba rten 'brel 'khor lo de nyid do// de la ma bsdam na lo gsum na mgrin par zhugs pas/ phyi rten 'brel du rgyal 'gong gis btsan la gtad/ btsan gyis dbang byas/ nang rten 'brel du phrag dog drag po skye/ nad rlung log dang mgul 'gags la sogs pa 'byung*/ gsang ba rten 'brel 'khor lo de nyid do// der ma bsdam na lo gsum na spyi bor zhugs nas/ phyi rten 'brel du klu'am/ sa bdag la gtad/ klus dbang byas/ nang rten 'brel du gti mug gis brgyal ba 'byung*/ 'di'i dus su lus la rtags thor re 'byung*/ skye bo blun po la rang la mthong chos su 'byung ba'i dus yin/ nang rten 'brel mi de gti mug shin tu che/ thig le nyams pa grangs mang*/ nad mi bzad pa mgo gzer rlung log 'ong*/ mdze drag po 'byung*/ gsang ba rten 'brel 'khor lo de nyid kyis byed pa yin/ las ngan gyi rlung spyi bor slebs pa'i dus 'dir/ 'di zlog kyang shin tu dka'/ ma log na mar gyi mtshams med dmyal bar 'gro/ de yang lo gsum po de rtag pa mthar 'dzin gyi dbang du byas pa yin/ de ma yin pa dus la nges pa med/ de la 'khrul 'khor dang dmigs pa gnyis kyis rlung smad du gnas pa'i thabs gal che/ chos thun gnyis pa'o// //yang skabs 'dir sems bskyed bya/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad sde snod gsum dang*/ rgyud sde bzhir 'dus/ de yang bla na med pa'i rgyud sder 'dus/ de yang pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis su 'dus/ de yang pha rgyud rlung gtso bor ston/ ma rgyud rtsa gtso bor ston/ rtsa thams cad rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhir 'dus/ rlung thams cad ldang 'jug gnas gsum du 'dus/ de'ang las thams cad rlung gis byed de/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ rlung zhes bya bas las kun byed// ces gsungs pas/ las ngan gyi rlung des 'khor lo stobs bskyed nas/

gnas skabs dang/ mthar thug thams cad du nyes pa 'ba' zhig bskyed par byed do// nyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i rgyu rlung yin te/ 'jig par byed pa'i rkyen gang yin na/ phyag rgya bzhis 'jig pa yin/ de la phyag rgyas bsdam bya dang sdom byed gnyis yin/ 'khor lo bzhi'i bsdam bya nyon mongs pa 'di yin/ de sdom byed gang yin na/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang nyon mongs pa spong ba'i tshul khrims dang*/ tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po las skyes pa'i byang chub kyi sems/ dbang zab mo las byung ba'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang lnga'o// dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba snying khong rus pa'i gting nas bar du gcod pa de rnams dag par byed pa la gsol ba btab pas/ nyon mongs pa rgyu 'bras dang bcas pa de rnams dag nas 'gro ba'i rgyu mtshan/ sangs rgyas nyon mongs pa spangs pa'i sku yin la/ chos de spong bar byed pa'i thabs yin/ dge 'dun spong ba la zhugs pa yin pas dag nas 'gro ba yin/nyi ma sbas pa dang gzhong ber gyi gtam rgyud kyang gsungs so/ dge bshes khams pa lung pas skyabs 'gro zhag gcig byas pas mdze sos pa yin/ de las tshangs pa'am/ khyab 'jug gam/ dbang phyug chen po'am/ 'o de gung rgyal la sogs pa la skyabs su song na/ mdze'am nad dam/ nyon mongs pa de rnams thu ru 'gro ba yin/ nyon mongs pa las skyes pas so// gnyis pa chos kyi phyag rgyas nyon mongs pa spong ba'i tshul khrims ni/ gong du bshad pa'i nyon mongs pa drag po skyes pa'i dus der spong ba'i dam bca' drag po byas pas gnyen po rgyud la skyes tsam na bral nas 'gro ba yin/ bir+wa pas 'dod chags drag po la gnyen po drag pos dngos grub brnyes pa yin/ gsum pa dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa yin/ de'ang e chung du snying rje drag pos mdze sos pa yin/

byams pa dang snying rje 'byams klas su bcug pas byang chub kyi sems skye/ byang chub kyi sems las byung ba'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis bsgoms pas nyes skyon de rnams 'dag pa yin/ rdzogs rim ni bka' gdams pa bzhin du stong pa rgyas 'debs pa min/ sems gdod ma nas phyag rgya chen por lhun gyis grub pa de bsgom pa yin/ de ltar bsgoms pas rtsa rlung thams cad phyag rgya bzhi'i rtsa rlung du 'gro ba yin/ chos thun gsum pa'o// phyag rgya bzhi dpa' bo dang 'dra/ dmigs pa mtshon dang 'dra/ kho bos e chung du snying rje drag pos mdze sos pa yin/ rdzogs rim sems gdod ma nas phyag rgya chen po lhun gyis grub pa de ltar dang*/ phyag rgya bzhi gnad du shes// //yang sems bskyed bya/ tshe snga ma phan chad kyi las ngan gyi lhag ma dang*/ tshe 'dir yang las ngan drag po byas pas rkang mthil gyi las rlung gyen la log pas/ smad kyi rlung stod du 'phos pas/ smad na rlung med sha ro 'byung*/ bem por 'gro/ har 'byung dbugs chad pa'i dus su ro rul nas 'gro ba yin/ stod du rlung 'phos pas smad na rlung med pas gdong pa sbos/ ro stod rgyas/ snying mi dga'/ snying rlung 'byung*/ rlung log dang*/ stod kyi rlung gzer 'byung*/ 'di bzlog pa la gdams ngag med na dka' ba yin/ de yang*/ bye brag tu go bar byas nas rkang pa'i sgyid khug la sha ro 'byung na des mig mi bde/ brang la byung na dpral ba mi bde/ rting pa la byung na mkhur tshos mi bde/ bol gong la byung na kha skyog por 'gro/ long bu la byung na rna ba gnyis la rtags 'byung*/ nywa mjug la byung na mgul 'gags 'byung*/ gsang gnas la byung na sna la 'byung*/ de rnams rtsa gnad gcig pa yin/ de la zo bde dang gting dag par byed pa yin/ zo bde la rtsa gsum 'dus mdor yi dam gyi lha mtshon gang pa zhig bsgom/ de'i sku las ye shes kyi me bshang lam du thon nas 'dom gsum tsam na mar bsrings pas/

rlung sems cung zad mar phebs nas zo lus khams bder 'gro/ gnyis pa gtan nas dag par byed ni/ mdze de 'jig par byed pa'i rkyen nam/ sel bar byed pa'i thabs la dben pa'i gnas su snying rus chen pos rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gnad du bsnun par bya/ gang gis gnad du bsnun na phyag rgya bzhis gnad du bsnun/ dang po lam du btang*/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba byas la gsol ba gdab/ de mdze'i rgyu nyon mongs pa de spong ba'i dam bca' drag po bya/ de nas tshad med pa'i snying rje las skyes pa'i byang chub kyi sems la bslab tu 'jug ro myong bar bya/ de nas dbang zab mo las skyes pa'i lhag pa'i lha bsgom la/ de thams cad phyag rgya chen po yin par rtogs par bya/ phyag rgya bzhi dpa' bo dang 'dra la/ dmigs pa mtshon cha dang 'dra bas/ dpa' bos bdag byas nas/ dmigs pa'i mtshon bsnun pa ni/ gsang gnas su yi dam gyi lha mtshon gang pa zhig bsgom/ de las ye shes kyi me 'dom gsum pa zhig bshang lam na mar thon nas/ sa 'og na mar 'ong bar bsams la/ de'i sna la dmigs pa gtad/ sems rtse gcig tu zhag bdun bsgom na tho lum pa la'ang sos pa la tshegs med/ me mar mi 'gro na gser gyi rdo rje btang*/ des rlung thur la 'drongs pas/ stod kyi nad de rnams bde bar 'gro/ smad du rlung zin pas sha ro la drod phebs pas/ thig le 'phel/ des sha ro la bskyed 'byung*/ rkang pa gnyis la sha ro byung ba'am/ skyon byung na bshang lam gyi dmigs pas mi sos pas/ g.yas na na g.yas kyi mthil nas mar ye shes kyi me sngar bzhin bsgom/ phra sbom ni/ dang po mdung tsam/ de nas mda' tsam/ de nas 'jag ma tsam bsgom/ dmigs pa phra na byin rlabs che ba yin/ g.yon pa la'ang des 'gre'o// des smad du rlung 'drongs nas/ sha ro la drod phebs nas bskyed 'byung ngo*// yang nad de 'don par 'dod na/ gong dang 'dra ba las/

khyad par du/ tshig gnyis po 'di la bka' rgya yod do// sems gang na gnas pa na rlung gnas pa yin/ rlung gang na gnas pa na sems gnas pa yin/ tshig gnyis po 'di la lan bdun bdun tsam bskyar ro// 'di'i go ba gang yin na/ lus kyi stod du sems gnas na/ rlung gyen la log nas stod du gnas te/ rlung log pa 'byung bas/ bla ma stod du sgom mi btub/ khyad par du spyi bor sgom mi btub/ des na ji ltar mtho zhing nyes pa che/ rlung log pa'i stobs che/ dper na khem gyi thag pa bsrings pas nar gyis yong ba dang 'dra bar 'pho ba'i las sbyor dang*/ thig le zlog pa'i skabs gnyis ma yin par/ bla ma mthon por bsgom du mi btub gsung*/ khyad par du snying rlung la snying gar bsgom du mi btub/ stod du nad glo bur ba byung na bsgom kyang 'gal ba med/ sems gar gnas pa ni rlung gnas pas/ sems smad du gnas na/ rlung smad du 'drongs pa/ stod kyi nad gang byung yang nad brgya sman gcig bya ba/ gsang gnas su bla ma bsgoms pas sel ba yin/ shag pho shag mo bsgoms kyang chog gsang gnas man chod kyi nad des sel mi nus pas/ bla ma'i sku las ye shes kyi me'am/ tshad pa yin na sum mdor 'dom gang tsam bshang lam na mar song bar bsam zhing dmigs pa gtad/ nag shod rgyal 'byung dang*/ bla ma rtsi lung pa'i nad rten 'brel gyi bcos dang 'dra/ rkang pa g.yas na ba la g.yas kyi dmigs pa/ g.yon na ba la g.yon dgos/ rtsang pa 'jam seng gi rten 'brel dang 'dra/ shin tu tshabs che na dmigs pa'ang shin tu dma' dgos/ khem thag gi dpe dang 'dra/ sum khrid kyi dmigs pa dma' bas nad sel ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ nad brgya sman gcig gis sel ba yin/ gag lhog gzer gsum sos mi thub pas/ dmigs pa la sogs pa bya'o// yang de ltar 'khor lor rlung zhugs pas/ nad mdze drag po byung ba'i dus su/ 'khor lo'i skyon gyis nyon mongs pa mi zad pa drag po skyes pa'i dus der/

snying rus chen pos nyams su blang bar bya/ de'ang nad dang gnod pa bar du gcod pa de rnams yon tan du 'char dgos pa yin pas/ thab khung nang gi me bsad na/ dkar khung gi du ba 'chad pa yin pas/ phyag rgya bzhis nyams su blangs pas/ rtsa rlung thig le phyag rgya bzhi'i rtsa rlung thig ler 'ong bas gong gi skyon de rnams dag nas/ yon tan 'ba' zhig tu 'ong ba yin/ mthun pa'i gnas dang grogs bsten/ 'phrod pa'i zas dang phyogs bsten dgos pa yin/ phyag rgya bzhi la gnad du bsnun/ las kyi rlung de lte bar slebs pa'i dus su/ chags pa drag po mi bzod pa skye/ de'i dus su sum chos kyis nyams su blangs pas/ chags pa de bde bar 'gyur/ bde ba la thig le'i dwangs ma zer ba lags/ khyad par du nyon mongs drag po skyes pa la/ sum chos kyis nyams su blangs shing gnad du bsnun pas/ rlung phyag rgya bzhi'i rlung du 'gyur/ thig le phyag rgya bzhi'i thig ler 'gyur bas/ thig le'i dwangs mas bde ba kha 'bus/ de nas bsgoms pas/ thig les lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo gang bas/ phyi rten 'brel du sprul pa'i sku mang po'i zhal mthong*/ nang rten 'brel du tha mal pa'i 'dod chags 'dag zag bcas kyi bde ba dpag tu med pa skye/ gsang ba rten 'brel 'khor lo de nyid do// yang snying gar slebs pa'i dus su/ phyi rten 'brel du phyag rgya chen po'i zhags pas chos thams cad dbang du sdud/ rtogs ldan gyi grags pa chen po 'byung*/ nang rten 'brel zag bcas kyi bde ba zag med du 'phos pas/ zag med kyi bde ba'i ngo bor mthong*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'od gsal don dam pa'i bde ba rgyud la skye'o// gsang ba rten 'brel 'khor lo de nyid do// yang bde ba'i dwangs mas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo gang bas/ phyi rten 'brel du snang sems ro gcig tu rtogs/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid rgyud la skye'o// nang rten 'brel rgyu 'bras mngon du 'gyur/

longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i zhal mthong*/ ngag gi bden pa thams cad 'grub bo// gsang ba rten 'brel 'khor lo de nyid do// de nas bde bas spyi bor gang bas/ dbang po thams cad bde bas gang*/ phyi rten 'brel du mngon par shes pa 'byung*/ nang rten 'brel du bde ba chen po'i sku rang he ru ka rdo rje 'chang byang chub sems gnyis mthar thug pa'i skur 'gyur/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang du gyur pas/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi bdag por gyur te/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor 'gyur ro// gsang ba rten 'brel 'khor lo de nyid do// bde bas spyi bo gang ba'i dus su/ dbu'i gtsug gtor gyen la 'phags/ gsang ba'i rdo rje sbubs su nub nas/ yar gyi mtshams med du 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur gsungs so// yang rnal 'byor bzhi dang sbyar nas bde bas lte ba gang bas/ rang la rtse gcig gi nyams skye/ de'i dus su 'dod chags shas che ba 'khor mang du 'byung*/ dgon pa'i sa yang dma' ba/ dog pa/ tshad khung che ba/ sa mi gtsang ba/ nyi ma 'char phyi ba/ rtsi shing mang ba 'byung ste/ lte ba dang cha mthun par 'byung ngo*// bde bas snying gar slebs pas/ nang du spros bral gyi rtogs pa skye/ snying ga zhe sdang gi yul yin pas 'khor zhe sdang can shas che ba 'byung*/ snying ga 'byung ba chu yin pas/ dgon pa grang ba yin/ rtsa 'dab nyung bas/ 'khor dang*/ dgon pa rtsi shing nyung*/ snying ga yangs pas dgon pa yangs pa'o// yang mgrin par slebs pas/ sgom ro gcig rgyud la skye'o// mgrin pa nyon mongs pa phrag dog gi 'byung sa yin pas/ 'khor yang phrag dog can 'byung*/ rtsa 'dab bcu drug yod pas/ sngar bas 'khor dang/ rtsi shing mang ba 'byung*/ mgrin pa dog pas dgon pa dog par 'byung*/ mgrin pa zas skom gyi rgyu sa yin pas/ dgon pa'ang zas skom thams cad kyi rgyu srang du yong zhing mod do// lam srang che/

chu chen po 'bab pa'i sa'o// mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i rdo rje rten 'brel lo// yang bde bas spyi bor slebs pas/ sgom med rgyud la skye'o// spyi bo na rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis yod pa dang chos mthun par 'khor yang bzang la mang*/ dgon pa'ang rtsi shing bzang la mang ba'o// sa mtho la snang yal che ba'i sar 'ong ba'o// kun gyis bkur ba'o// de la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad go bar bya'o// chos mang du gsungs kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen skal ldan gyis zhus nas rgyas par byon pa'i dus su/ shākya'i dge slong grags pa 'byung gnas kyis bzung nas yi ger bkod pa'o// shin tu zab pa dang gnyan pas yi ge spel na dam tshig dang 'gal lo// // ༄// sum chos gnad kyi man ngag tshangs par spyod pa'i khrid// na mo gu ru/ yang gzhan dang thun mong ma yin zhing khyad par 'phags pa'i sum chos 'di'i thog mar snga ba/ gnas 'bam thang du sgom chen pa brtul zhugs grub pa mang po la gsungs te/ dus der chos 'di'i ming tshangs par spyod pa'i man ngag bya bar mtshan btags/ de nas dus phyis tshogs chen por mdzad pa'i sum chos yin pas/ 'di la sngon 'gro tshogs kyi 'khor lo sngar bas kyang rgya che bar mdzad cing*/ bye brag tu rtsa rlung thig le'i gnad ston pas gtor sha dgos gsung nas rgyan dmar po'i khyad par tsam zhig mdzad de/ gzhan ni sngar dang 'dra'o// de la chos gsungs pa ni/ zhal mnga' nas spyir nga 'bu la sgrub pa byas pa'i dus su nyams su myong ba dang rtogs pa'i chos zab mo mang po'ang yod pa yin/ de la chos 'di ni ngas mi'i bla ma las thob pa min te/ sangs rgyas dang bar na brgyud pa gzhan med/ de'i chos de gang yin sum chos 'di lags pas/ 'di khyed la snyan du gsol/ 'di ltar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ji snyed cig gsungs pa de thams cad nyon mongs pa 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs pa yin/

de'ang 'dod chags kyi gnyen por nyi khri chig stong*/ zhe sdang gi gnyen por nyi khri chig stong*/ gti mug gi gnyen por nyi khri chig stong*/ cha mnyam pa'i gnyen por nyi khri chig stong*/ de ltar brgyad khri bzhi stong yin la/ de bsdu na sde snod gsum yin pas/ de'ang 'dod chags kyi gnyen por 'dul ba'i sde snod/ zhe sdang gi gnyen por mdo sde'i sde snod/ gti mug gi gnyen por mngon pa'i sde snod yin te/ de yang nyon mongs pa dug gsum 'dul ba yin te/ de la mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gnyis la/ nyams su len lugs tha dad pas/ dang po mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas nyon mongs pa spang bya dang gnyen po gnyis kyi tshul du spang ngo*// des phyi'i nyon mongs pa rags rim zhig 'joms par byed/ gnyis pa gsang sngags pas nyon mongs pa de nyid spang gnyen gnyis su med par lam du byed/ des nang gi nyon mongs pa shin tu phra ba bag la nyal dang bcas pa 'joms pas/ tshe 'dir yang gsang sngags rdo rje theg par 'tshang rgya ba yin te/ de lta bu'i chos sangs rgyas gzhan gyi bstan pa la ma byung bas/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gnad 'di la/ khyed kyis 'dzin bde ba'i ched du sa bcad kyi dmigs lngar bgyi bas sum chos/ de'ang rten gyi gang zag ji lta bu dang*/ dam pa'i chos gang yin pa dang*/ nyams su blang ba'i tshul lugs gang yin pa dang*/ sgrib pa ji tsam zhig 'dag pa dang*/ 'bras bu gang thob pa dang lnga lags/ dang po de la rten gyi gang zag ji lta bu yin na/ slob dpon rgyal po lta bu yin pas/ de yang sngon bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa lha dbang phyug chen pos gangs ti se la gdan drangs nas zhag bco lnga bzhugs te/ dbang phyug chen po dang*/ u ma 'khor dang bcas pas mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur dpag tu med pas mchod nas rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la gshegs pa dang*/

sham bha la'i grong khyer chen po na/ rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi 'khor dang bcas pa pho brang gi steng na 'dug pa'i thog tu grib ma babs nas rgyal pos 'di ci yin brjod pas/ blon po zhig na re 'di sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yin zer/ sangs rgyas zhes bya ba ji lta bu yin dris pas/ shākya'i rigs las rab tu byung ba sangs rgyas pa'i bar du rgyas par brjod pas/ 'o na de 'o skol gyis gdan drangs na 'byon nam zer ro// des gzhan gyi bsam pa mkhyen pas gsol ba btab na 'byon byas pas/ de nas rgyal pos pus mo sa la btsugs nas thams cad kyis gsol ba btab pas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa pho brang du byon pa la/ mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur dang zhabs tog byas shing gdugs tshod gsol nas stan dma' ba la 'dug nas chos zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nyon mongs pa rnam par spong ba dang*/ 'dod pa la zhen pa'i 'ching ba rnam par bcad nas rnam par grol ba'i 'bras bu thob pa'i chos bstan pa la rgyal pos de ma 'dod de/ lum+bi'i tshal ni nyams dga' bar// wa nyid seng ger gyur kyang ni// 'dod pa spangs pa'i thar pa ni// gau tam nam yang mi 'tshal lo// zhes gsol ba btab pas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po de 'dul ba'i dus su mkhyen nas skad cig de nyid pho brang de nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa'i gzhal yas khang du sprul te bcom ldan 'das nyid zhe sdang rdo rje/ yum reg bya rdo rje ma dang gnyis su med par snyoms par zhugs pa la/ 'khor dgra bcom pa thams cad kyang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor sprul nas bzhugs pas/ rgyal pos de mthong nas dad par gyur te/ 'di lta bu grub par byed pa'i thabs zhu zhes zhus pas/ gnas der dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud gsungs shing*/ chos bstan pas rgyal po 'khor bcas mkha' spyod du gshegs pa lta bu'am/ yang na 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma zas su sha za ba/ btung bar khrag 'thung ba/

las su 'dod chags spyod pa lta bu rnams yin/ dus da lta ni nged rang rnams lta bu yin/ bsam pa gcig gi steng du nyon mongs pa dug gsum dus gcig tu skye ba/ da lta rang sangs rgyas ba bas 'dod chags spyod pa la gdams pa/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las skyob pa'i bla ma dam pa bas shag pho shag mo'i a ka la dga' ba lta bu yin/ de lta bu'i rten gyi gang zag de/ chos 'di'i snod du 'gyur bas skal ba dang ldan par bshad de/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang ji tsam du nyon mongs pa shas che ba de tsam du gnyen po'i stobs cher bskyed nas spang bya spong zhing gnyen po'i stobs su 'gyur bas tshegs med par dngos grub thob pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ gnyis pa/dam pa'i chos 'di rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud nas nyon mongs pa de nyid ma spangs par lam du byed pa yin te/ mdor na nyams len dga' ba bzhi ston par byed pa yin pas/ rten las kyi phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang*/ 'khyud pa dang 'o byed pa rnam 'gyur sen mo 'debs pa la dga' ba/ rdo rje dang pad+ma mnyam par sbyor ba mchog dga'/ bsrubs pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor ba la gnas pa dga' bral/ gnyis shor gnyis mnyam par gnas pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba yin te/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de mngon du byas pas bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ba ste/ brtag gnyis las/ dang po dga' ba 'gro ba'i gzugs// gnyis pa mchog dga' 'gro ba'i gzugs// gsum pa dga' bral 'gro ba'i gzugs// bzhi pa spangs pa nyid kyi phyir// lhan cig skyes pa byang chub brjod// ces gsungs pas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams len dga' ba bzhi ston pa yin/ gsum pa nyams su blang ba'i tshul lugs la bzhi yin pas/ theg pa chen po spyir gsang sngags gsungs pa'i tshul/ tshul khrims rin po che nyams su blang ba/ gdams ngag gang yang rung ba bsgom pa/ thugs kyi dgongs pa'i snying po dang bzhi yin/

de la gsang sngags spyi ltar na phun sum tshogs pa lngas nyams su len pas 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo zhig bsgom pa la mtshon na/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang rdo rje'am 'khor lo sdom pa lta bu yin te/ lha yab yum zhal sbyor/ gnas sham+bha la'am yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ chos gsang ba 'dus pa'am bde mchog 'khor dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs/ dus de rnams 'dzom pa'i dus sam/ yar mar gyi tshes bcu dang bcu bzhi pa yin no// de ltar rnal 'byor pas nyams su blangs pas rgyud la bde ba chen po'am/ 'dod chags chen po bskyed/ yi dam lha yab yum zhal sbyor bsgoms kyang 'dod chags chen po skye/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhir phyin yang de skye ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ de na lha dbang phyug chen po dang yum u ma'i rten rang byung yod/ des chags pa'i stobs skye bas/ 'phan yul pha gi na gnas gzhi zhig gi ltag na lha dbang phyug chen po'i rten zhig yod pa de nam mgo 'bur gyis byung ba dang*/ btsun pa thams cad dus gcig tu sdom pa 'chor skad do// de lta bu de dag gnas yin/ 'khor grol lam pas grogs dam tshig dang ldan pa ni/ chags lam pas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i las kyi phyag rgya yin te/ des kyang chags pa'i stobs bskyed par byed pa yin/ dus ni spyir snyigs ma bdo ba'i dus kyang yin la/ dus gnyan pa zla ba'i mtshams la sogs pa yin te/ 'di'i dus su nang gi khams 'phel 'grib kyi dus yin pas/ nyon mongs pa'i stobs 'phel bas bsgom pa'i dus gnad yin/ sman pa kun kyang bla gnas kyi rtsa 'khyams zer nas gtar sreg kyang spong*/ yang gnas sam 'khor gyi khongs su 'du bas rtsa'i zas phun sum tshogs pa sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ chang dang bcud len dang*/ da byid kyi sbyor thabs rnams dang*/ thod pa srub med pa la sogs pa chags pa bskyed pa'i rdzas sna tshogs bsten pa'i tshul yang gsungs te/

mdor na de thams cad kyis nyon mongs pa chags pa'i stobs 'phel bar byed pa yin/ phyi ltar bshad pa'i phun sum tshogs pa lnga ni/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa sham+bha la/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa gsang ba 'dus pa/ chos phun sum tshogs pa gsang 'dus kyi rgyud/ 'khor dpa' bo dang dpa' mo/ dus tshe thung nad mang ba snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus so// nang ltar bshad pa'i phun sum tshogs pa lnga ni/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa lhar bsgom pa/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa rtsa khams kyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo/ chos phun sum tshogs pa dga' ba rnam pa bzhi/ dus phun sum tshogs pa nyon mongs pa skye dus der nyams su blang ngo*// yang na/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'am/ dge sbyor 'phel ba'i gnas der/ chos phun sum tshogs pa dga' ba bzhi rgyud la skyed byed kyi rgyu mthun lnga ste/ cong zhi la sogs thig le 'phel byed kyi rdzas nus pa can yod pa/ rdzas ni lus zung 'phel byed kyi sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'o// grogs ni pho nya'i lam pa yin na las rgya ma sogs bsten/ grol lam pa yin na bde ba skyed byed kyi yul lo// dus 'dod chags skyes dus su gdams ngag nyams su blangs pas 'dod chags ma skyes dus las khyad par du 'phags te/ sngar las bcu drug 'gyur gyi ting nge 'dzin skye ba yin gsung*/ ting nge 'dzin la gnyis te/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis so// bskyed rim bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i lha yab yum zhal sbyor bsgom pa/ rdzogs rim gtum mo la sogs bsgoms pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes skye ba yin gsung*/ gnyis pa tshul khrims rin po che bcom ldan 'das kyis dgag pa'i bslab par gsungs la/ rma'i sgo gsum du bcug reg nyams su myong na pham pa'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bar pa yan lag gi rnam pa las bsrubs te khu ba phyung ste lhag ma'o zhes pa dang*/ tha ma yan lag gi rnam pa 'chang ba dang blta na nyes byas so// zhes gsungs pas/

de thams cad bkag pas khu ba mi nyams par lus la gnas te gnas pa de nyid la me tog dang dri'i tshul du 'dod chags drag po skye/ chags pa de'i rjes su 'brangs nas las ngan spyad na ngan 'gro'i gnas su ltung bas lus la khams gnas dgos so// rmi lam du nyams pa la nyes pa med par gsungs kyang bsgrub par ma nus pa las rmi lam du dud 'gro dang*/ skyes pa dang bud med gang la yang nyams kyang nyes skyon 'byung bas thul gog mang po gon pa dang*/ sked dkris sum rim byas pa'i btsun mo yang ci yin shes/ dka' thub bya ba lus kyi zungs skem par byed pa yin zer te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mtha' gnyis dang bral bar spyod pa la dbu ma'i lam du gsungs pas/ lam de nyams su blangs na khams kyi stobs de 'phel/ des drod dang ting nge 'dzin thams cad skye bas bcom ldan 'das kyang chos gos gsum gyis nga 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rigs su 'khrungs pa skyid bde bar gnas pa'ang grang sar dros na khyed rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes gsungs pas/ chos gos gsum las lhag pa ma gnang bas gos lhag po spang ba dang*/ snga dro kha zas rags pa rnams dang*/ phyi dro ka ra bu ram rnams dang*/ sbrang rtsi dang zhun mar dang*/ zhag la sogs pa'i bcud thams cad gnang bas khams kyis stobs 'phel zhing ting 'dzin skye ste/ mdor na tshul khrims bsrungs pas kyang chags pa'i stobs 'phel bar 'byung ba yin gsung*/ gsum pa gdams ngag gang yang rung ba dpal nā ro pa'i chos drug gam/ zhi byed dam/ rdzogs chen nam/ phyag rgya chen po'am/ yi dam gyi lha'am/ rtsa rlung thig le gang bsgoms kyang phyi rol gyi yul gang la'ang ma yengs par sems nang du gnas pas rlung nang du log des gtum mo'i me 'bar/ des khams thams cad zhu nas chags pa'i stobs 'phel ba yin no// bzhi pa thugs kyi dgongs pa'i gnad ni/ gsang sngags sam/ tshul khrims sam/ gdams ngag gang rung gis bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu de byung ba'i dus su 'bad pa chen po'i snying rus kyis byang chub kyi sems ma nyams pa gal che/

'dod chags kyi bsam pas shor na dngos grub shor ba yin/ chags pa spyad na dam tshig nyams te rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bsad de ngan song du 'gro/ dus 'dir bdud ris kyi lhas kyang bar chad brtsam pas de las rgyal na dngos grub da lta thob pas/ gsang sngags kyi man ngag gi gnad rnams dus der yod pas man ngag che chung dus 'dir gsal/ chags lam gyi rigs mang po'i nang nas/ gzung ba dang*/ bzlog pa dang*/ 'grems pa la sogs pa'i gdams ngag dang*/ sngags dang rdzas dang*/ 'khrul 'khor gyi bsrung ba la sogs pa mang po shes te thub par shin tu dka'/ nga'i gdams ngag 'di bzhin du nyams su blangs pa na nub mo rmi lam tshun chod thub par 'ong bas dbang po'i sgo bsdams nas yul la ma yengs par nyams su blangs pas the tshom med pa yin no// de la chos 'di la rtsa ba'i gnad kyis tshig la'ang bcu chos kyi bka' rgya dang 'dra ba yin pas gsang bar bya ba yin te/ gdams ngag gi gnad thun mong ma yin pa nyon mongs pa'i dri ma sbyong bar byed pa yon tan rin po che sgrub par byed pa/ bka' gnyis pa bka' rgya dang bcas pa'i man ngag rgya dang bka' nan gtsigs dang bcas pa'i yi ge'i sum chos kyi man ngag gsum ni/ nyon mongs pa lam du gtong ba'i man ngag bde chen byang chub sems kyi man ngag theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi man ngag go/ ris la ma btab pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa gtan la phab pa/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi srog gi snying po de ji ltar gsungs pa ltar nyams su blangs/ yang dang po nyon mongs pa lam du byed pa'i man ngag ni/ lam du btang ba ni rang la nyon mongs pa drag po skye ba'i dus su nyon mongs pa de nyid rang gis shes pas btsir gyis bzung la khab mig tu skud pa brgyus pa'am/ gzhu bdungs pa'i tshad tsam du ma yengs par byas la lam du gtong*/ yun shes rab snying po tshar gcig bklag pa'i tshad tsam du gnad la dbab/

de nas gnyis pa byang chub sems kyi man ngag ni/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de gong du spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil yan chad kyi thig le g.yo bas/ de dug la sngags kyis btab pas sman du 'gyur ba bzhin du byang chub kyi sems dang gnyis su med pa'i bde bar ro gcig pas phyi rol du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa'i zhal mthong ba'i gnad yod/ de nas gsum pa theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi man ngag ni/ yi dam lha bla ma phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'o/ yi dam gyi lha bsgoms pas phyag mtshan dang gdan dang*/ rgyan dang ba spu'i bu ga tshun chod gsal bar the tshom med/ lar bu kun 'di 'dra ba'i man ngag gi gnad med par ri khrod du bsdad kyang stong sdug yin/ gnad 'di yod na dngos grub dang yon tan thams cad thob pa la tshegs med/ gnad 'di med pa nyon mongs pa ma spangs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod kyang mi 'ong*/ 'di yod na rang nyid lto 'grangs pas zas za snying mi 'dod pa dang 'dra bar/ rang gi lus la bde ba'i stobs yod pas gzhan yul las mi 'tshol/ rang nyid ltogs pa zas la 'dod pa drag po 'byung ba bzhin du rang lus la bde ba mi gnas pas yul gzhan la 'tshol ba'ang de yin no// bzhi pa sgrib pa ci tsam zhig 'dag na nyon mongs pa phra ba bag la nyal dang bcas pa 'dag ste/ nan tan chen pos nyams su blangs pas yul la chags pa'i zhen pa log cing*/ sems la bde ba chen po rgyas pas/ snang srid bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du 'char te/ de ltar brtag gnyis las/ bde ba dkar po bde ba ser// bde ba dmar po bde ba ljang*// bde ba rgyu dang mi rgyu kun// zhes gsungs pa yin no// lnga pa 'bras bu thob na gnas skabs su phrin las bzhi dang grub chen brgyad la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad dang*/ mthar thug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob pa la tshegs med de/ rang gi myong bas grub pa yin/

de ring gi chos 'di lta bu thob nas khyed rnams ri khrod du sgrub pa la nan tan gyis dang*/ dngos grub mi thob pa'i dogs pa med de/ lar khyed rnams la chos 'di mi 'chor bar nga rang la tshur 'khor nas 'ong bar 'dug gsungs so// dpal ldan chos rje bla ma dam pa'i bka'// zab mo gnad kyi snying po bsdus pa 'di// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i srog snying yin pas na// yi ger bri bar 'os pa ma yin kyang*// skyes chen gsung 'di gcog par ma nus pas// 'gro mgon zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa yi// ban sdom shes rab 'byung gnas zhes bya bas// shin tu gus pas gsol btab yi ger bkod// 'di la 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis pa// mnyam med bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog gsum// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad kyis// thugs brtser dgongs la bzod pa mdzad par zhu// dri med dge bas bla med rdzogs sangs rgyas// skyon med byang chub myur du thob gyur nas// mtshungs med chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor zhing*// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal nyon mongs gcod par shog /yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i gdams pa rdzogs so// // ༄// sum chos bka' rgya ma// rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'dir theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi brjod bya nyon mongs pa thabs lam du byed pa la/ de yang rten 'brel ring ba'i gnad la shin tu mkhas dgos te/ dper na srub shing srub stan dang*/ skyes bu'i lag pa'i rtsol ba gsum las me 'byung zhing*/ me de bsrub shing las kyang ma yin te/ srub gdan las kyang ma yin/ skyes bu'i lag pa'i rtsol ba las kyang ma yin te/ rten 'brel tshogs pa las me 'byung ba de bzhin du/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i las rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang/ rang la khams byang chub kyi sems thig le'i mthu chen po gnas pa dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gi gnad gsum gyi rten 'brel tshogs pa las/

bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngo 'phrod pas gsang sngags kyi yon tan ji snyed cig 'byung ba dang/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa la dka' las med pa de/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud 'di nas/ las kyi phyag rgya'i gnad 'di byung bas ngo mtshar ba ste/ rmad du byung ba'i thabs bya ba lags te/ de ltar yang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ sgyu ma dag ni thams cad las// bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags gsungs// de la las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon sum du 'char bar byed pa 'di/ bka' brgyud rin po che 'di la dpal ldan nā ro pa'i khyad chos yin/ de yang dpal ldan phag mo gru pas kyang*/ nga 'bu rang ma gtogs pa gzhan su la yang ma gnang ba'i rigs su 'dug de la las kyi phyag rgya yid kyis bsten pa dang/ dngos su bsten pa gnyis yin/ dngos su bsten pa de rab byung la bkag nas/ yid kyis bsten pa'i thabs rnams gsungs te gzhan du gsal/ dngos su bsten thabs zhal las shes so// rdzogs so// // ༄// sum chos rnam dag chos sku'i 'od zer// bla ma rin po che la gus par phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// zhal gyi gdams pa 'di la don rnam pa gnyis te/ bka' rgya med pa'i chos dang*/ bka' rgya dang bcas pa'i chos so// dang po la rnam pa lnga ste/ rten gyi gang zag dang gcig nyams su blangs ba'i chos dang gnyis/ nyams su blang pa'i thabs dang gsum*/ sgrib pa ji tsam 'dag pa dang bzhi/ 'bras bu gang thob pa dang lnga'o// dang po ni/ brtson 'grus che la yid thung ba/ nyon mongs pa shin tu rags pa'i gang zag yin te/ rgyal po in+d+ra bho dhi lta bu yin gsungs/ de yang sham bha la'i pho brang du rgyal po in+d+ra bho dhi yang rtse na bzhugs pa'i dus na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa nam mkha' la gshegs pa mthong*/ 'di su yin zhes blon po la dris pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa ri bo gangs can la byon nas/

da lhor gshegs pa yin zhes so// 'o na gsol ba btab na 'byon nam dris pa dang*/ 'byon par 'ong zhes so// der zhu ba gsol ba dang*/ rgyal po'i pho brang du byon/ bsnyen bkur rgya chen po mdzad pa dang*/ chos zhus pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pas 'dod pa spong ba'i chos gsungs pas rgyal po'i zhal nas/ lum bi'i tshal ni nyams dga' bar// wa ni seng ge gyur kyang ni// 'dod pa spangs pa'i thar pa de// gau'u tam nam yang mi 'tshal lo// zhes zer ba dang*/ 'dod pa spangs mi dgos par sangs rgya ba'i thabs yod gsungs pas/ rgyal po dga' nas zhu ba phul bas/ se gol cig gtogs pa tsam gyis/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur nas zhal bstan/ de nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud nyan/ nyams su blangs pas mchog gi dngos grub thob nas/ dpon slob thams cad mkha' spyod du gshegs pa yin gsungs/ nyams su blangs rgyu'i chos de ni theg pa chen po gsang sngags rgyud sde rin po che rnam pa bzhi/ khyad par du yang rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud yin gsungs/ nyams su blangs bar bya ba'i thabs ni/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i tshul du nyams su blangs te/ phyi ltar bshad pa'i dbang du byas na/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa sham bha la lta bu/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa gsang ba 'dus pa/ chos phun sum tshogs pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro bye brag tu rgyal po in+d+ra bho dhi lta bu/ dus tshe thung nad mang snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus so// nang ltar bshad pa'i dbang du byas na/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa rang nyid yi dam gyi lha bsgom/ 'khor dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rang nyid kyi la lus la gnas pa'i rtsa dang thig le nyid dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'o// chos phun sum tshogs pa dag pa bzhi/ dus phun sum tshogs pa nyon mongs pa nam skyes pa'i dus de nyid du nyams su len/

gnas phun sum tshogs pa yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa lta bu gang na ting nge 'dzin 'phel bar byed pa'i gnas so// chos phun sum tshogs pa dga' bzhi rgyud la skye bar byed pa la/ de'i rgyu mthun rnam pa lnga ste/ mthun pa'i rdzas dang*/ gnas dang*/ dus dang*/ grogs dang*/ sa ma ti'o// dang po ni sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ da byid la sogs pa'i sha dang*/ thabs shes kyi rdzas te mdor na lus zung thig le 'phel bar byed pa'i rgyu bcud len gyi rnam pa ji snyed gsungs pa rnams bsten par bya'o// gnas ni nyon mongs pa 'dod chags skye bar byed pa ste/ de ni thig le 'phel bar byed pa'i rgyu cong zhi la sogs pa'i rdzas nus pa can yod pa yin pas brtul zhugs can gyi gnas phun sum tshogs pa yin/ dus nyon mongs pa nam skyes pa'i dus la khyad du 'phags te/ bcu drug 'gyur gyis mi phod pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ba yin no// grogs ni pho nya'i lam pa yin na phyag rgya bsten pa yin la/ grol lam pa yin na mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i sbyin bdag dang*/ nye gnas la sogs pa yin no// ting nge 'dzin la rnam pa gnyis te/ bskyed pa'i rim pa ni bdag byin gyis rlob pa lha yab yum zhal sbyor du bsgoms pa la brten nas/ byang chub kyi sems 'phel ba dang rgyas pa dang*/ brtan par 'gyur ba yin gsungs/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni 'khor lo bzhi la brten nas/ gtum mo dang*/ rmi lam dang*/ 'od gsal la sogs pa rim pa bzhin du nyams su blangs pas/ khams byang chub kyi sems shin tu rgyas par byed pa yin gsungs/ mdor na de rnams kyis byang chub sems kyis thig le 'grub par byed pa yin la/ de yod na dga' ba rnam pa bzhi rgyud la skye ste/ de'i gtso bo spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skye bar byed pa la tshegs med pa yin no// sgrib pa gang 'dag na shes bya'i sgrib pa 'dag

'bras bu gang 'thob na rdo rje 'chang chen po'o go 'phang thob ste/ de rnams ni theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi nyams su len pa spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa'o// de ltar dben pa'i gnas su nyams su blangs pas ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye/ des rlung nang du log nas drod skye/ des thig le kha 'bus nas byang chub kyi sems rgyas/ des nyon mongs pa 'dod chags rgyas pas nyes pa thams cad kyi gzhir gyur ba yin gsungs/ 'di'i dus su brtul zhugs chen po dgos pa yin te/ bod la sgom chen mang yang grub thob nyung ba de/ brtul zhugs chung ba dang*/ gdams ngag gi gnad ma shes pas lan pa yin gsungs/ 'di'i dus su brtul zhugs can gyi gang zag gis/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag la brten pa nyams su blang na myur du dngos grub thob pa yin gsungs/ 'di rnams bka' rgya med pa'i chos yin gsungs so// gnyis pa bka' rgya can gyi chos rnam pa gsum ste/ de la nyon mongs pa lam du byed pa ni/ nyon mongs pa gang skyes pa thams cad lam du btang ste/ lam du btang lugs ni dper na 'dod chags lta bu zhig la mtshon na/ 'dod chags mngon 'gyur drag po rgyud la skyes pa'i dus su/ bdag gi nyon mongs pa 'dod chags 'dis/ bdag dang khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa 'dod chags thams cad bdag gi 'dis dag par gyur cig snyam du snying thag pa rus pa'i gting nas lam du btang ste/ lam du thengs pa'i tshad ni bde bas shes pa tshim pa'am/ ro myong rgyu zhig byung ba'i dus su lam du thengs pa yin gsungs/ des 'dod chags kyi rnam par rtog pa dang bral ba'i 'bras bu bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye ba yin gsungs/ des nyon mongs pa lam du byed pa'i man ngag go// bde chen byang chub sems kyi man ngag ni/ bde ba skyes pa'i dus der byang chub mchog tu bskyed pas/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/

bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin gnyis su med par 'gyur te/ de la bde chen byang chub sems kyi man ngag zhes bya ste/ byang chub kyi sems tshan po che rgyud la skye ba yin gsungs/ gsum pa theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi man ngag la gsum ste/ yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa dang*/ bla ma snying gi dbus su bsgom pa dang*/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'o// dang po ni byang chub kyi sems la rkang chogs ma thag tu/ rang lus yi dam gyi lha gang yin pa der bsgom te de yang 'dod chags ma skyes pa'i dus su bsgom pa de bas skyes pa'i dus su bsgom pas sngar bas bcu drug 'gyur gyis shin tu gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes te/ ches te zhal yang mthong*/ ma mthong yang mthong ba dang 'dra ba'i lha shin tu gsal po 'byung ba yin gsungs/ bla ma dang phyag rgya chen po bsgoms pa yin/ bla ma dang phyag rgya chen po sgom pa yang de dang 'dra 'gres te/ rnam par rtog pa'i rlung gi mi g.yo ba'i ting nge 'dzin yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ba yin gsungs/ nyon mongs pa gzhan yang des 'gres te/ lam du thengs na sngar bas bcu drug 'gyur gyis gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur te gzhan ma yang de bzhin du shes par bya'o gsungs/ zhe sdang skyes pa'i lam du thengs na de dang bral ba'i 'bras bu gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye ste/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pas gsal chen byang chub sems kyi man ngag de'i rjes la yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa de bzhin no// gti mug lam du thengs pas bral ba'i 'bras bu la/ mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye/ byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas/ rtog med byang chub sems kyi man ngag zhes bya bar 'gyur te/ nyams su len lugs dang*/ gsal ba la sogs pa'i yon tan gong ma dang 'dra ba yin gsungs/ de kho na bzhin du nyams su blangs na/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa yin gsungs/

tshig gsum po 'di ni/ rje rin po che nyid kyis thugs las 'khrungs pa/ gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa thun mong ma yin pa'i chos yin pas na/ bka' rgya shin tu dam ste/ yar bla ma la mi bshad/ phar grogs po la mi bshad/ mar slob ma la gnyis las/ lto kha yar snying ston/ kha phyir ston pa'i slob ma la mi bshad/ glo snying brang gsum ston pa'i slob ma la bka' rgya med pa yin gsungs/ gang zag gsum la gnang ba'i chos kyi rim pa phog pa yin pas/ rnal 'byor pas 'di shes dgos/ go dgos gsungs/ rdzogs so// / // ༄// sum chos zhal gdams bde chen mkha' 'gro'i srog snying dri ma med pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi// oṃ swa sti/ dug lnga ye shes lnga dang rgyal ba lngar// ma spangs gdod nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// he ru ka dpal bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// lhun grub bde chen rin chen zhabs la 'dud// kun kyang tshe 'dir mchog gi sku thob phyir// de yi gdams ngag cung zad bdag gis yi ger bri// de la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ 'di ltar thub pa chen po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyu dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ bar du bskal pa dpag tu med par bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ tha ma rdo rje gdan gyi spo la/ srod la gnyug ma byams chen gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis bdud btul/ tho rangs 'od gsal chen po ye shes kyis shes bya'i sgrib pa'i bud shing ma lus par bsregs nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ des rigs can rnam pa gsum la chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa gsum skor ba yin/ de yang rgyas par phye na/ nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs/ mdor bsdus na nyon mongs pa chags sdang rmongs gsum du 'dus pas/

chos kyi sgo mo yang sde snod gsum du 'dus/ de yang 'dod chags kyi gnyen por 'dul ba'i sde snod/ zhe sdang gi gnyen por mdo sde'i sde snod gsungs/ gti mug gi gnyen por mngon pa'i sde snod gsungs pa yin/ 'dir nyams su len pa'i dus su lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pas 'dod chags spong*/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pas zhe sdang spong*/ lhag pa shes rab bslab pas gti mug spong*/ de bslab pa gsum gyis nyams su len pa la theg pa chung ngu dang theg pa chen po nyams su len pa gnyis/ theg pa chung ngu ba rang nyid zhi bde 'dod pa'i bsam pas/ bslab pa gsum nyams su blangs kyang bsam pa de 'grub pas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub ma gtogs pa/ bla na med pa'i byang chub mi thob/ rgyu med pa'i 'bras bu mi srid/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung ba la rgyu dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed dgos te/ byang chub kyi sems yod na sangs rgyas yod/ byang chub kyi sems med na sangs rgyas med/ 'di med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras bya ba yin/ theg pa chen po la byang chub kyi sems bslab pa rin po che gsum nyams su blangs pas/ bsam pa de 'grub pas de'i 'phrin las mi 'dzad cing*/ sems can ma zad kyi bar du sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa 'ong*/ theg chen po la'ang gnyis/ mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa gnyis/ mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa la/ 'dod chags kyi gnyen por mi sdug pa bsgom pa dang*/ zhe sdang la byams pa/ gti mug la rten 'brel/ de ltar spang bya gnyen pos spong zhing*/ bskal pa grangs med pa gsum na sangs rgya/ 'o na lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngo sprod pa med dam byas pa la/ de yod de rtogs par byed pa la khyad yod pa yin te/

theg pa chen po gsang sngags thabs mang bas khyad par du 'phags pa yin/ thabs zab shos thabs che bas khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas/ tshe gcig gi rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa yin te/ de ltar yang sid+dhi ka ra legs par grub pa'i rgyud las/ thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang*// dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas pas// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// bya ba gsungs/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pas nyon mongs pa rags pa 'dul ba yin/ sngags kyis phra ba bag la nyal dang bcas pa 'dul/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi thabs khyad par can gyis nyon mongs pa lam du byed pa yin/ thabs gang yin snyam na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod chags che 'bring bzhi lam du byed pa la/ rgyud sde rin po che bzhi gsungs pa lags te/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis/ ltas dang rgod dang lag 'chang dang*/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang sbyor sogs kyis// gsungs pas/ de la gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams gcig la gcig chags pa skyes pa'i dus su/ phan tshun gcig la gcig bltas pas chags pa'i gdung ba spyod par byed/ de lam du byed pa la bcom ldan 'das kyis bya ba'i rgyud gsungs/ de nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pas bltas pas tshim pa'i 'dod chags de mi spong bar lam du byed pa la yi dam gyi lha yab yum phan tshun blta ba bsgom pa yin no// 'phrul dga' ba rnams lha pho mo chags pa skyes pa'i dus su phan tshun rgod pas chags pa'i gdung ba spyod par byed/ de lam du byed pa la spyod pa'i rgyud gsungs/ 'dir nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pas yi dam gyi lha yab yum phan tshun bzhad par bsgom pa yin/ dga' ldan gyi lha pho mo gnyis chags pa skyes pa'i dus su lha pho mo gnyis kyi lag pa'i mthil du pad ma re re skyes nas 'ong ba yin par 'dug de phur bas 'dod chags kyis gdungs pa spyod par byed/ de lam du byed pa la rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs/

'di nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pas yi dam gyi lha yab yum phyag bcangs pa sgom pa yin/ sum cu rtsa gsum man chod kyi 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha mi rnams kyis pho dang mo chags pa skyes pa'i dus su/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa'i sbyor bas 'dod chags kyi gdungs pa spyod par byed/ 'dod chags de lam du byed pa la/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen pos rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud gsungs/ 'dir nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pas gnyis gnyis 'khyud pas tshim pa'i 'dod chags de mi spong bar lam du byed pas/ yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa yang yab yum zhal sbyor 'khyud pa bsgom pa yin/ de min pa ltar sgom pa min te/ rang gi tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum po 'di gdod ma nas sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs su lhan cig skyes par 'dod de/ de ltar yang 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas rgyud sde rin po che bzhi ni/ bya ba'i rgyud spyod pa'i rgyud dang bla med do// dang po lus spyod gtso bor ston// gnyis pa ngag spyod gtso bor ston// gsum pa sems spyod gtso bor ston// bzhi pa lhan skyes 'ba' zhig go// bya ba gsungs pas/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi bzhed pas sku lhan cig skyes pa/ gsung lhan cig skyes pa/ thugs lhan cig skyes pa gsungs so// sku lhan cig skyes pa ni/ rang gi rdo rje'i lus 'di phung po lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga/ 'byung ba bzhi lha mo bzhi/ lhan cig skyes pa de ltar yang*/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu grags// zhes gsungs so// lus 'di la rtsa dang rlung dang thig le la sogs pa 'di rnams kyang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i sku yin te/ rtsa 'di rnams kyang 'khor lo'i mdud pa'am/ la la ni lha yab yum/ de bzhin du thig le dkar po thabs/ dmar po shes rab/

rlung gi dbang du byas na/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga/ lha yab rigs lngar gsungs pa dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi'am lnga ste yum bzhi'am lngar gsungs te/ mdor bsdus par gyur na/ rdo rje'i lus 'di la gdod ma nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku lhan cig skyes pa/ gsung lhan cig skyes pa ngag gis ci smra ba thams cad ā li kā li'i thabs shes rab gnyis med sangs rgyas kyi gsungs du gnas/ thugs lhan cig skyes pa rang gi sems gdod ma nas chos kyi sku yin zhing*/ rkyen las skyes pa'i rnam par rtog pa de thabs yin/ de'i rang bzhin stong pa ste shes rab ste shes rab yum/ de ltar lhan cig skyes pa sangs rgyas kyi thugs su gnas pas/ gdod ma nas sangs rgyas yin zhes ngo sprad do// de la kha cig na re// lus sangs rgyas kyi skur bstan pa 'di/ don ci yin zer ba yod de ma go ba yin/ 'di don rang gi mtshan nyid yin/ 'o na yon tan med zer na/ nor bu rin po che yin pa la rang gi dgos 'dod 'byung bar rigs/ mgo bre rang gis mchod pa byas pas 'ong zer na/ 'dir yang sbyangs pas 'ong byas/ de ltar gdod ma nas sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yin pa de/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma dang 'phrad pa'i dus su/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs su ngo sprad nas nyon mongs pa mi spong bar de nyid thabs mkhas pas nyams su blangs pas rdzogs pa'i byang chub tshe gcig gi thob pa yin/ de ltar/ 'dod chags nyid kyis 'dod chags 'dag /bya ba gsungs/ nyon mongs pa ma spangs par de nyid sangs rgyas su dag pa yin te/ de la gsum/ chos kyi sku rnam par dag pa dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnam par dag pa dang*/ sprul pa'i sku rnam par dag pa'o// de la chos kyi sku rnam par dag pa ni/ nyon mongs pa rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa yin te/ nyon mongs pa gsum skyes pa'i skye med chos kyi skur rtogs pa yin/

slob dpon dpal ldan nā ro pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'dod chags bde chen zung du 'jug /zhe sdang 'od gsal zung du 'jug /gti mug rtog med zung du 'jug /bya ba gsungs/ 'dod chags rang byung gi ye shes chen por bya ba dang/ sku gnyis thabs mkhas pas khyad par du byas pa'o// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnam par dag pa ni/ zhe sdang rnam par dag pa rdo rje mi bskyod pa/ 'dod chags rdo rje mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa dang*/ gti mug rdo rje bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad du byas/ sprul pa'i sku rnam par dag pa ni sems can gyi khams gang la gang 'dod du 'ong ba yin te/ dman pa'i sprul pa dang*/ mchog gi sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'ong ba yin/ de ltar yin pa'i shing phung che na me phung che/ gsungs/ nyon mongs pa che na ye shes che/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/ de la shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su/ bskal pa sum cu rtsa gsum du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad pa las/ 'dir snga dro gcig dka' ba spyad pa la yang bsod nams che gsung*/ de'i rgyu mtshan gang yin na nyon mongs pa 'dod chags shin tu rags pa yin te/ bag la nyal med par mngon gyur du skye ba yin/ khyod rang rnams lta bu yin/ de la chos ji lta bu zhig bstan byas pa la/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas/ brtson 'grus che la yid thung ba'i// de la gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa bstan gsungs/ de la rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud 'di rgyud sde 'og ma gsum po las zab pa yin gsungs/ de yang rang gi rgyud la mngon gyur du skyes pa'i nyon mongs pa 'di lam du byed pa'i sngags kyi rang skad ci tsam du nyon mongs pa che ba tsam du/ thabs mkhas pas nyams su blangs pas gnyen po rang gzugs su 'gyur bas/ tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin no// 'di spyi'i chings yin/ 'di la sa bcad kyi dmigs pa lnga byas pas/

khyed kyis 'dzin bde ba yin pas zung du gsol zhig rten gyi gang zag ji lta bu/ dam pa'i chos gang yin pa/ nyams su blangs pa'i tshul lugs/ sgrib pa ji tsam 'dag pa/ 'bras bu gang thob pa'o// rten gyi gang zag gi dbang du bgyis na/ 'dod chags chen po ldan pa'i gang zag slob dpon rgyal po in+d+ra bho dhi lta bu yin/ de bzhin du khyed rang rnams kyang 'dod chags chen po da lta rang sangs rgyas pa bas kyang*/ chags pa thengs gcig spyod pa la dga' ba'i 'dod chags chen po dang ldan pas nga'i gcig shos 'dir 'byung ba yin/ de ltar rten gyi gang zag ni/ 'dod chags chen po dang ldan pa/ slob dpon rgyal po lta bu'o// da gnyis pa dam pa'i chos gang yin pa ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud/ 'dod chags lam du byed pa'i thabs 'di rnams yin te/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi lugs kyi 'khor 'das kyi yon tan thams cad 'dod chags 'di la gnad du song bas 'ong bar bzhed/ dam pa'i chos 'dod chags chos kyis sbas pas nyams su blangs ba'i tshul lugs rnam pa lnga la/ phun tshogs lngas nyams su blangs ba dang gcig tshul khrims rin po che dang gnyis/ gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa li dang gsum/ phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag gis rigs tha dad pa dang bzhi/ nga rang gis zhe 'dod dang lnga yin/ de la dang po phun sum tshogs pa lngas nyams su len pa ni/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ chos phun sum tshogs pa/ gnas/ 'khor/ dus phun sum tshogs pa lnga/ de la ston pa ni drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po/ he ru ka yab yum zhal sbyor ram/ lha pho reng mo reng bsgom kyang 'dod chags skye/ chos ni dga' ba rnam pa bzhi yin te/ de yang dga' ba/ mchog tu dga' ba dang*/ dga' bral dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba dang*/ de yang blta ba dang reg pa dang*/ 'o byed pa dang*/ nu ma nyed pa la sogs pas nyams ci skye byed pa dga' ba/ rdo rje dang pad+ma snyoms par 'jug pas nyams ci skye byed pa thams cad/

sngar bar mchog tu dga' ba mchog dga'/ de nas srubs pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor bas thig le rdo rje'i bum par slebs pas/ sngar bas mchog tu dga' ba dang dga' rgyu yang med pas dga' bral/ gnyis shor gnyis gnas dus su lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'o// dga' ba bzhi po 'di 'dod chags che 'bring bzhi yin gsungs/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ de na mu stegs pas lha rten dbang phyug chen po dang*/ lha mo u ma de ba'i rten yod pas/ der bsdad na 'dod chags chen po skye/ 'phan yul ma gi'i gnas chung gcig na/ lha dbang phyug chen po'i rten yod pa 'dug de sas byibs kyis 'jog pa la de mgo nam bteg byung ba'i dus su gnas chung de'i btsun pa tsho sdom pa dus gcig la shor ba yin par 'dug /de'i nus mthu dang dbang yod pa min/ 'khor ni las kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ zas ni sha za/ btung ba ni khrag 'thung*/ las su 'dod chags spyod pa ni rnams yin te/ mdor na chags pa skye ba'i grogs phyag rgya mtshan nyid dang ldan pa de lta bu thos pa'am/ mthong bas chags pa skye ba/ de lta bu la reg pa'am 'o byed pa dang/ rdo rje pad+ma snyoms par 'jug pa dang/ bsrub pa la sogs pa 'dod chags chen po skye ba yin te/ 'di yang shin tu dka' ba yin par 'dug jo bo rje'i zhal snga nas/ bod na dge slong rje btsun min pa mi 'dug gsung skad/ dus ni tshes brgyad/ bcu dang*/ nyi shu lnga dang*/ dgu/ stong la sogs dus bzang po'i dus su 'dod chags drag po skye ba yin/ mdor na chags pa nam skyes dus de phun sum tshogs pa yin/ gzhan yang rdzas kyi skye ba yang yod de/ ka pa la srub med pa yod na de rten pa'am/ de'i nang du chang la sogs pa 'thungs pa tsam gyis chags pa skye ba yin/ gzhan yang bcud len gyi rigs dang*/ bu ram chang dang*/ 'bru'i chang dang*/ me tog gi chang la sogs pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i chang gi bya thabs dang nus pa phan yon la sogs pa gsungs pa des kyang chags pa skye/

'o skol gyi chang 'di lta bu la zer ba min/ da byid kyi rigs sbyar bas kyang skye/ 'di la kha cig na re/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba nas phyi dro'i kha zas bkag pa de lus kyi rgyas pa bskyed nas bkag zer te/ de tsug min/ chos spyod bcu'i rgyud las/ don dang bya ba mang bas bkag par gsungs pa yin/ dgong mo bu ram pa la sogs bcud chen gnang nas 'dug dam pa'i chos 'dul ba nas sbal pa dkar po'i sha yang gnang nas 'dug ste/ de da byid du 'dug gzhan kha zas bcud can gyi skye'o// tshul khrims rin po che nyams su blangs pa ni/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhal snga nas/ tshul khrims rin po che 'di nyid gsang sngags yin/ de yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin na/ sngags kyi phun sum tshogs pa lngas kyang 'dod chags skye bar byed 'dug la/ 'dir yang tshul khrims bsrungs pa bas khams byang chub sems mi nyams stobs 'phel/ stobs 'phel nas 'dod chags skye ba yin/ ltung ba sde lnga nas 'dod chags la gnyis su gsungs/ phyi yul lam 'dod yon la chags pa'i 'dod chags dang*/ nang sems can la chags pa'i 'dod chags spang ba gnyis su gsungs/ yul la chags pa spong ba la gnyis/ 'dod pa bsod nyams kyi mtha' spong ba dang*/ lus ngal dub kyi mtha' spong ba'o// 'dod pa bsod nyams kyi mtha' spang ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas sangs mi rgya bar dgongs nas de spangs nas rab tu byung*/ dka' thub lo drug mdzad/ des kyang lus ngal dub tu song nas don mi 'byung bar dgongs nas ba stong gi 'o thug sbrang rtsi gsol bas sku gser gyi rten pa phyis pa 'dra bar gyur pa dang*/ nang sems can la chags pa'i 'dod chags ni/ dge slong gcig 'dod chags skyes pa la dbang po brdung pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/ brdung bar bya ba mi brdung bar/ mi brdung bar bya ba brdungs gsungs/ mu stegs kyi dka' thub lus 'dul bar byed pa lta bu yin/

lus dum bu brgyar gtub kyang mi phan/ nang pa lus 'dul bar byed pa ma yin/ nang pa sems 'dul bar byed pas nang pa yin/ de ltar mtha' gnyis spangs nas tshul khrims bsrungs pas skye/ gsum pa gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa li sgom pas drod skye/ khams byang chub kyi sems zhu/ des 'dod chags drag po rang dbang med pa skye/ gdams ngag gi rigs tha dad pas kyang skye ste/ yi dam gyi lha sgoms rung*/ rdzogs pa chen po zhi byed dam/ rtsa rlung thig le'am/ phyag rgya chen po'am/ nyams su gang blangs kyang skye/ skye ba'i rgyu mtshan yul la ma yengs par bsgoms pas sems zin/ sems zin pas rlung nang du ldog rlung ldog pas rtsa dral/ rtsa dral bas drod skye/ drod skyes pas thig le zhu zhing 'phel bas 'dod chags drag po rang dbang med pa skye/ de'i dus su nga'i gdams ngag med na/ bu smad can du 'gro ba yin/ lnga pa nga rang gi zhe 'dod 'di la bka' rgya'i chos dang 'dra'o// 'di la rtsa tshig gsum po 'di'i ming mdo rgyud dang*/ gdams ngag gzhan na bzhugs pa min/ nga rang gis btags pa yin/ rnal 'byor pa chos la myong ba skyes pa'i dus su kha nas ci byung 'don pa yin/ phun sum tshogs pa lngas gcig shos drag po skye yang rung*/ tshul khrims bsrungs pas skyes kyang rung*/ gtum mo bsgoms pas kyang rung*/ gdams ngag gi rigs tha dad pas skyes kyang rung*/ phyag rgya chen pos yul rkyen la brten nas yul rkyen med par skyes kyang rung*/ gcig shos drag po skyes pa'i dus su 'di ltar bya/ da gcig shos drag po skyes pa'i dus su 'di ltar bya/ da gcig shos kyi dngos gzhi ston pa yin te/ 'dir nyon mongs pa rtogs par byed pa lam du byed pa'i gnad gcig ston pa yin/ 'dir yang khyed rang rnams la snyan du gsol ba'i chos lnga ldan las lhag pa med/ 'on kyang rtsa rlung thig le gsum gyis gnad cig ston pa 'di dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyis srog tu song bas tshogs 'khor med kha med/
